title: PDMD: Projected Distribution Matching Distillation for Video Diffusion Models

paragraphs.en: Modern video diffusion models require tens of denoising evaluations over long spatiotemporal token sequences. Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) reduces the number of function evaluations (NFE) to just a few. However, DMD samples can degrade during training, exhibiting progressive oversaturation and artifacts. We trace this instability to critic errors, which enter successive student updates and accumulate over time. We introduce Projected Distribution Matching Distillation ( PDMD ) to filter critic errors. PDMD projects out the component of the DMD update parallel to the student–critic endpoint residual. At a fixed noisy query, we prove that this residual is an unbiased estimate of the critic’s endpoint error. Under high-dimensional assumptions, this projection removes a constant fraction of critic error while discarding only a vanishing fraction of ideal DMD signal. Empirically, the projection stabilizes training and improves sample quality where DMD degrades and develops unnatural textures. PDMD requires only a one-line code change to DMD, with no extra loss, network, data, model pass, or multi-stage training. With Wan2.1, PDMD achieves a VBench total score of 83.73 at 4 NFE, surpassing matched DMD by 1.03 points. On MiniMax-H3 joint video–audio generation, PDMD achieves a VideoGen-Eval visual total score of 83.17, 0.41 points above the strongest distilled baseline. PDMD also achieves the best performance on all six audio metrics among the compared 4-NFE models. Qualitative comparisons and user studies favor PDMD over the distilled baselines in visual quality, motion, and audio quality. Code and models are available at https://pdmd2026.github.io/ .
paragraphs.zh: 现代视频扩散模型需要在漫长的时空令牌序列上执行数十次去噪评估。 分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）将函数评估次数（NFE）减少至仅几次。 然而，DMD 的样本在训练过程中可能会退化，表现出渐进式的过度饱和和伪影。 我们将这种不稳定性归因于批评者误差，这些误差会进入连续的学生更新并随时间累积。 我们引入了投影分布匹配蒸馏（PDMD）来过滤批评者误差。 PDMD 会将 DMD 更新中与学生-批评者端点残差平行的分量投影出去。 在固定噪声查询下，我们证明了该残差是批评者端点误差的无偏估计。 在高维假设下，这种投影会移除批评者误差的一个恒定比例，同时仅丢弃理想 DMD 信号中一个趋近于零的比例。 经验表明，这种投影能够稳定训练并提升样本质量，尤其是在 DMD 出现退化和不自然纹理的地方。 PDMD 仅需对 DMD 进行一行代码修改，无需额外的损失函数、网络、数据、模型遍历或多阶段训练。 使用 Wan2.1，PDMD 在 4 NFE 时获得了 83.73 的 VBench 总分，比匹配的 DMD 高出 1.03 分。 在 MiniMax-H3 联合视频-音频生成任务中，PDMD 获得了 83.17 的 VideoGen-Eval 视觉总分，比最强的蒸馏基线模型高出 0.41 分。 PDMD 在所有六个音频指标上也实现了所比较的 4-NFE 模型中的最佳性能。 定性比较和用户研究表明，PDMD 在视觉质量、运动和音频质量方面优于蒸馏基线模型。 代码和模型可在 https://pdmd2026.github.io/ 获取。

paragraphs.en: “A marble kraken rises in a storm” “ PDMD lands the knockdown on DMD” “A sunset ride”
paragraphs.zh: “风暴中升起的白色章鱼” “PDMD将DMD击倒” “日落骑行”

paragraphs.en: “One snowboard jump: takeoff, grab, landing”
paragraphs.zh: “单板滑雪跳台动作一次：起跳、抓板、落地”

paragraphs.en: Video generation has advanced rapidly in visual quality, motion fidelity, and prompt following, as demonstrated by Sora ( Brooks et al., 2024 ) , Wan ( Team Wan et al., 2025 ) , Seedance ( ByteDance Seed, 2025 ) , and MiniMax ( MiniMax, 2026a ) . This progress comes at substantial inference cost: a modern video diffusion transformer ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Peebles & Xie, 2023 ) typically requires a large number of function evaluations (NFE), often dozens, each processing a long spatiotemporal token sequence. Step distillation ( Salimans & Ho, 2022 ; Song et al., 2023 ) reduces this cost by compressing a many-step teacher into a few-step student that requires only a few evaluations. Distribution Matching Distillation ( DMD ) ( Yin et al., 2024b ) is a widely used approach to step distillation. It trains the student to match the distribution produced by the many-step teacher, using the difference between the student score (learned online by a model called the critic) and the frozen teacher score.
paragraphs.zh: 视频生成在视觉质量、运动保真度和提示遵循方面取得了快速进步，Sora（Brooks 等人，2024）、Wan（Team Wan 等人，2025）、Seedance（ByteDance Seed，2025）和 MiniMax（MiniMax，2026a）均证明了这一点。 这种进步伴随着高昂的推理成本：一个现代视频扩散变换器（Rombach 等人，2022；Peebles & Xie，2023）通常需要大量的函数评估（NFE），往往达到数十次，每次都需要处理一个长时空间令牌序列。 步骤蒸馏（Salimans & Ho，2022；Song 等人，2023）通过将多步教师模型压缩为只需少量评估的几步学生模型来降低这一成本。 分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）（Yin 等人，2024b）是一种广泛用于步骤蒸馏的方法。 该方法通过利用学生得分（由一个称为“评论家”的模型在线学习得到）与冻结的教师得分之间的差异，训练学生模型以匹配多步教师模型所生成的分布。

sents.zh: 分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）（Yin 等人，2024b）是一种广泛用于步骤蒸馏的方法。

sents.en: It trains the student to match the distribution produced by the many-step teacher, using the difference between the student score (learned online by a model called the critic) and the frozen teacher score.
sents.zh: 该方法通过利用学生得分（由一个称为“评论家”的模型在线学习得到）与冻结的教师得分之间的差异，训练学生模型以匹配多步教师模型所生成的分布。

paragraphs.en: The critic is trained alternately with the student, using student-generated samples to track current student’s distribution. However, the online critic has approximation error even for a fixed student and can lag behind a changing one. ( Shao et al., 2025 ; Yin et al., 2024a ) . Because the critic score enters the DMD update directly, critic errors are repeatedly transferred to the student and can accumulate throughout training. The critic error can lead to training instability, with samples becoming progressively oversaturated and eventually losing quality ( Shao et al., 2025 ; Yin et al., 2024a ) . For example, on MiniMax-H3, DMD becomes visibly oversaturated from 500 iterations onward ( Figure 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 批评智能体与学生智能体交替训练，利用学生智能体生成的样本来跟踪当前学生智能体的分布。 然而，即使面对固定的学生智能体，在线批评智能体仍存在近似误差，并且可能滞后于不断变化的学生智能体。 （Shao 等人，2025；Yin 等人，2024a）。 由于批评智能体的评分会直接输入 DMD 更新过程，因此批评智能体的误差会被反复传递给学生智能体，并可能在整个训练过程中累积。 批评智能体的误差可能导致训练不稳定，样本会逐渐过度饱和，最终质量下降（Shao 等人，2025；Yin 等人，2024a）。 例如，在 MiniMax-H3 上，从第 500 次迭代开始，DMD 明显变得过度饱和（图 2）。

sents.en: For example, on MiniMax-H3, DMD becomes visibly oversaturated from 500 iterations onward ( Figure 2 ).
sents.zh: 例如，在 MiniMax-H3 上，从第 500 次迭代开始，DMD 明显变得过度饱和（图 2）。

paragraphs.en: DMD2 ( Yin et al., 2024a ) reduces critic errors by taking more critic updates per student update, and also adds a discriminator to improve quality. Other methods combine DMD with additional objectives ( Zheng et al., 2026 ; Gu et al., 2026 ) . We look beyond these additions and ask whether DMD can reduce critic error using what it already computes. Our goal is to use an estimate of the critic error direction that costs no extra data or model pass, to cancel part of the critic error with the estimate, and keep most of the DMD signal. Our key insight is that the direction from the student sample to the critic’s one-step denoised prediction, namely the student–critic endpoint residual, provides an estimate of the critic error direction ( Section 4.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: DMD2（Yin 等人，2024a）通过每次学生更新时执行更多评论家更新来减少评论家误差，同时还添加了一个判别器以提升质量。 其他方法则将 DMD 与额外的目标函数相结合（Zheng 等人，2026；Gu 等人，2026）。 我们超越了这些附加改进，进一步探讨 DMD 是否可以利用其已计算出的内容来减少评论家误差。 我们的目标是利用一个无需额外数据或模型遍历即可获得的评论家误差方向估计值，用该估计值抵消部分评论家误差，同时保留大部分 DMD 信号。 我们的关键洞见是：从学生样本到评论家单步去噪预测的向量方向，即学生-评论家端点残差，提供了评论家误差方向的估计值（第 4.1 节）。

paragraphs.en: To filter and attenuate critic error, we present Projected Distribution Matching Distillation ( PDMD ), which projects out the parallel component to the critic error estimate of the DMD update. PDMD is a one-line change to DMD , with no auxiliary objective, network, model pass, data, or training stage. Under high-dimensional concentration and weak-alignment assumptions, our analysis shows PDMD removes a constant fraction of critic error and only a vanishing fraction of useful DMD signal.
paragraphs.zh: 为了过滤并削弱批评者误差，我们提出了投影分布匹配蒸馏（PDMD），该方法将 DMD 更新中批评者误差估计的平行分量投影出去。 PDMD 是对 DMD 的单行修改，无需任何辅助目标、网络、模型传递、数据或训练阶段。 在高维集中和弱对齐假设下，我们的分析表明，PDMD 能够消除批评者误差的一个恒定比例，而仅消除微乎其微的有用 DMD 信号。

sents.en: To filter and attenuate critic error, we present Projected Distribution Matching Distillation ( PDMD ), which projects out the parallel component to the critic error estimate of the DMD update.
sents.zh: 为了过滤并削弱批评者误差，我们提出了投影分布匹配蒸馏（PDMD），该方法将 DMD 更新中批评者误差估计的平行分量投影出去。

sents.en: PDMD is a one-line change to DMD , with no auxiliary objective, network, model pass, data, or training stage.
sents.zh: PDMD 是对 DMD 的单行修改，无需任何辅助目标、网络、模型传递、数据或训练阶段。

sents.en: Under high-dimensional concentration and weak-alignment assumptions, our analysis shows PDMD removes a constant fraction of critic error and only a vanishing fraction of useful DMD signal.
sents.zh: 在高维集中和弱对齐假设下，我们的分析表明，PDMD 能够消除批评者误差的一个恒定比例，而仅消除微乎其微的有用 DMD 信号。

paragraphs.en: As illustrated by Figure 3 , PDMD recasts improving DMD as a filtering problem inside the existing update. DMD re-noises a student sample 𝒙 0 s \bm{x}_{0}^{s} to 𝒙 t \bm{x}_{t} and evaluates the critic score 𝒔 critic \bm{s}_{\mathrm{critic}} and the frozen teacher score 𝒔 teacher \bm{s}_{\mathrm{teacher}} at the same query. The score difference, 𝒅 = 𝒔 critic − 𝒔 teacher \bm{d}=\bm{s}_{\mathrm{critic}}-\bm{s}_{\mathrm{teacher}} , defines its student update. However, the critic error within 𝒔 critic \bm{s}_{\mathrm{critic}} is not directly observable, and cannot simply be subtracted from 𝒅 \bm{d} . The critic score can be linearly converted to a one-step endpoint 𝒙 0 c \bm{x}_{0}^{c} with no extra model pass. Fortunately, the student–critic endpoint residual 𝒓 = 𝒙 0 c − 𝒙 0 s \bm{r}=\bm{x}_{0}^{c}-\bm{x}_{0}^{s} is observable and a critic error estimator. For a fixed query 𝒙 t \bm{x}_{t} , the ideal critic endpoint is the average student endpoint. Therefore, the observed student–critic endpoint residual estimates critic error, with a sample-variation term that averages to zero. We prove that, at a fixed query 𝒙 t \bm{x}_{t} , 𝒓 \bm{r} is an unbiased estimate of the critic endpoint error in Equation 7 . Projecting out the component of 𝒅 \bm{d} parallel to 𝒓 \bm{r} suppresses critic error. A visual example is provided at right of Figure 3 .
paragraphs.zh: 如图 3 所示，PDMD 将改进 DMD 的问题重构为现有更新过程中的一个滤波问题。 DMD 对学生样本 𝒙₀ˢ \bm{x}_{0}^{s} 进行重新加噪得到 𝒙ₜ \bm{x}_{t}，并在同一查询时评估批评者得分 𝒔_critic \bm{s}_{\mathrm{critic}} 和冻结教师得分 𝒔_teacher \bm{s}_{\mathrm{teacher}}。 得分差值 𝒅 = 𝒔_critic − 𝒔_teacher \bm{d}=\bm{s}_{\mathrm{critic}}-\bm{s}_{\mathrm{teacher}} 定义了其学生更新。 然而，𝒔_critic \bm{s}_{\mathrm{critic}} 中的批评者误差无法直接观测，也不能简单地从 𝒅 \bm{d} 中减去。 批评者得分可以通过线性转换得到一步终点 𝒙₀ᶜ \bm{x}_{0}^{c}，而无需额外的模型遍历。 幸运的是，学生–批评者终点残差 𝒓 = 𝒙₀ᶜ − 𝒙₀ˢ \bm{r}=\bm{x}_{0}^{c}-\bm{x}_{0}^{s} 是可观测的，并且是批评者误差的估计量。 对于固定的查询 𝒙ₜ \bm{x}_{t}，理想的批评者终点是学生终点的平均值。 因此，观测到的学生–批评者终点残差可以估计批评者误差，其中包含一个样本变异项，其平均值为零。 我们证明了，在固定查询 𝒙ₜ \bm{x}_{t} 时，𝒓 \bm{r} 是方程 7 中批评者终点误差的无偏估计。 将 𝒅 \bm{d} 中与 𝒓 \bm{r} 平行的分量投影出去，可以抑制批评者误差。 图 3 右侧提供了一个直观的示例。

sents.en: As illustrated by Figure 3 , PDMD recasts improving DMD as a filtering problem inside the existing update.
sents.zh: 如图 3 所示，PDMD 将改进 DMD 的问题重构为现有更新过程中的一个滤波问题。

sents.en: DMD re-noises a student sample 𝒙 0 s \bm{x}_{0}^{s} to 𝒙 t \bm{x}_{t} and evaluates the critic score 𝒔 critic \bm{s}_{\mathrm{critic}} and the frozen teacher score 𝒔 teacher \bm{s}_{\mathrm{teacher}} at the same query.
sents.zh: DMD 对学生样本 𝒙₀ˢ \bm{x}_{0}^{s} 进行重新加噪得到 𝒙ₜ \bm{x}_{t}，并在同一查询时评估批评者得分 𝒔_critic \bm{s}_{\mathrm{critic}} 和冻结教师得分 𝒔_teacher \bm{s}_{\mathrm{teacher}}。

sents.en: The score difference, 𝒅 = 𝒔 critic − 𝒔 teacher \bm{d}=\bm{s}_{\mathrm{critic}}-\bm{s}_{\mathrm{teacher}} , defines its student update.
sents.zh: 得分差值 𝒅 = 𝒔_critic − 𝒔_teacher \bm{d}=\bm{s}_{\mathrm{critic}}-\bm{s}_{\mathrm{teacher}} 定义了其学生更新。

sents.en: However, the critic error within 𝒔 critic \bm{s}_{\mathrm{critic}} is not directly observable, and cannot simply be subtracted from 𝒅 \bm{d} .
sents.zh: 然而，𝒔_critic \bm{s}_{\mathrm{critic}} 中的批评者误差无法直接观测，也不能简单地从 𝒅 \bm{d} 中减去。

sents.en: The critic score can be linearly converted to a one-step endpoint 𝒙 0 c \bm{x}_{0}^{c} with no extra model pass.
sents.zh: 批评者得分可以通过线性转换得到一步终点 𝒙₀ᶜ \bm{x}_{0}^{c}，而无需额外的模型遍历。

sents.en: Fortunately, the student–critic endpoint residual 𝒓 = 𝒙 0 c − 𝒙 0 s \bm{r}=\bm{x}_{0}^{c}-\bm{x}_{0}^{s} is observable and a critic error estimator.
sents.zh: 幸运的是，学生–批评者终点残差 𝒓 = 𝒙₀ᶜ − 𝒙₀ˢ \bm{r}=\bm{x}_{0}^{c}-\bm{x}_{0}^{s} 是可观测的，并且是批评者误差的估计量。

sents.en: For a fixed query 𝒙 t \bm{x}_{t} , the ideal critic endpoint is the average student endpoint.
sents.zh: 对于固定的查询 𝒙ₜ \bm{x}_{t}，理想的批评者终点是学生终点的平均值。

sents.en: Therefore, the observed student–critic endpoint residual estimates critic error, with a sample-variation term that averages to zero.
sents.zh: 因此，观测到的学生–批评者终点残差可以估计批评者误差，其中包含一个样本变异项，其平均值为零。

sents.en: We prove that, at a fixed query 𝒙 t \bm{x}_{t} , 𝒓 \bm{r} is an unbiased estimate of the critic endpoint error in Equation 7 .
sents.zh: 我们证明了，在固定查询 𝒙ₜ \bm{x}_{t} 时，𝒓 \bm{r} 是方程 7 中批评者终点误差的无偏估计。

sents.en: Projecting out the component of 𝒅 \bm{d} parallel to 𝒓 \bm{r} suppresses critic error.
sents.zh: 将 𝒅 \bm{d} 中与 𝒓 \bm{r} 平行的分量投影出去，可以抑制批评者误差。

sents.en: A visual example is provided at right of Figure 3 .
sents.zh: 图 3 右侧提供了一个直观的示例。

paragraphs.en: The filtering shows up empirically as more stable training, less oversaturation, more motion, and better audio. In 2D analysis, PDMD improves energy distance, on-mode fraction, and collapses to a single mode in 3 / 20 3/20 runs, against 14 / 20 14/20 without the projection ( Figure 5 ; Supp. Table B3 ). On Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B, PDMD reaches 83.73 total score on VBench, 1.03 points above its matched DMD baseline ( Table 1 ). On MiniMax-H3-33B joint video–audio generation, it reaches 83.17 total score on VideoGen-Eval, 0.41 above the strongest distilled baseline, and obtains the highest scores on all six audio metrics among 4-NFE models ( Table 2 ). User studies prefer PDMD to every 4-NFE baseline on visual, motion, and audio quality ( Table 2 and Table 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 过滤效果在实证中表现为训练更稳定、过饱和更少、动态表现更强以及音频质量更佳。 在二维分析中，PDMD 提升了能量距离和模式占比，并在 3/20 次运行中坍缩为单一模式，而未进行投影时该比例为 14/20（图 5；补充表 B3）。 在 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 模型上，PDMD 在 VBench 测试中获得了 83.73 的总分，比其匹配的 DMD 基线模型高出 1.03 分（表 1）。 在 MiniMax-H3-33B 联合视频-音频生成任务中，它在 VideoGen-Eval 测试中获得了 83.17 的总分，比最强的蒸馏基线模型高出 0.41 分，并且在所有 4-NFE 模型中，其六项音频指标得分均最高（表 2）。 用户研究结果显示，在视觉、动态和音频质量方面，PDMD 优于所有 4-NFE 基线模型（表 2 和表 1）。

sents.en: The filtering shows up empirically as more stable training, less oversaturation, more motion, and better audio.
sents.zh: 过滤效果在实证中表现为训练更稳定、过饱和更少、动态表现更强以及音频质量更佳。

sents.en: In 2D analysis, PDMD improves energy distance, on-mode fraction, and collapses to a single mode in 3 / 20 3/20 runs, against 14 / 20 14/20 without the projection ( Figure 5 ; Supp. Table B3 ).
sents.zh: 在二维分析中，PDMD 提升了能量距离和模式占比，并在 3/20 次运行中坍缩为单一模式，而未进行投影时该比例为 14/20（图 5；补充表 B3）。

sents.en: On Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B, PDMD reaches 83.73 total score on VBench, 1.03 points above its matched DMD baseline ( Table 1 ).
sents.zh: 在 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 模型上，PDMD 在 VBench 测试中获得了 83.73 的总分，比其匹配的 DMD 基线模型高出 1.03 分（表 1）。

sents.en: On MiniMax-H3-33B joint video–audio generation, it reaches 83.17 total score on VideoGen-Eval, 0.41 above the strongest distilled baseline, and obtains the highest scores on all six audio metrics among 4-NFE models ( Table 2 ).
sents.zh: 在 MiniMax-H3-33B 联合视频-音频生成任务中，它在 VideoGen-Eval 测试中获得了 83.17 的总分，比最强的蒸馏基线模型高出 0.41 分，并且在所有 4-NFE 模型中，其六项音频指标得分均最高（表 2）。

sents.en: User studies prefer PDMD to every 4-NFE baseline on visual, motion, and audio quality ( Table 2 and Table 1 ).
sents.zh: 用户研究结果显示，在视觉、动态和音频质量方面，PDMD 优于所有 4-NFE 基线模型（表 2 和表 1）。

paragraphs.en: We connect DMD ’s training instability and visual degradation to critic error in its score-difference update, and identify the student–critic endpoint residual as an estimate of the critic error.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 DMD 的训练不稳定性和视觉退化归因于其分数差异更新中的批评者误差，并将学生-批评者端点残差视为批评者误差的估计值。

paragraphs.en: We introduce PDMD , a simple and effective algorithm that filters critic error by projecting out the component of the DMD update parallel to the student–critic endpoint residual. Under high-dimensional assumptions, PDMD removes a constant fraction of this error while losing only a vanishing fraction of useful signal.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种简单而有效的算法 PDMD，它通过将 DMD 更新中平行于学生-批评家端点残差的分量投影出去，从而过滤掉批评家的误差。 在高维假设下，PDMD 能够消除这一误差的恒定比例，同时仅损失微乎其微的有用信号。

sents.en: We introduce PDMD , a simple and effective algorithm that filters critic error by projecting out the component of the DMD update parallel to the student–critic endpoint residual.
sents.zh: 我们提出了一种简单而有效的算法 PDMD，它通过将 DMD 更新中平行于学生-批评家端点残差的分量投影出去，从而过滤掉批评家的误差。

sents.en: Under high-dimensional assumptions, PDMD removes a constant fraction of this error while losing only a vanishing fraction of useful signal.
sents.zh: 在高维假设下，PDMD 能够消除这一误差的恒定比例，同时仅损失微乎其微的有用信号。

paragraphs.en: Experiments show improved energy distance and on-mode fraction in 2D, better visual quality on Wan2.1, and better video and audio quality on MiniMax-H3. User studies also favor PDMD .
paragraphs.zh: 实验表明，在二维场景中，能量距离和在线模式比例得到改善；在 Wan2.1 上，视觉质量更优；在 MiniMax-H3 上，视频和音频质量也更好。 用户研究同样更青睐 PDMD。

sents.en: Experiments show improved energy distance and on-mode fraction in 2D, better visual quality on Wan2.1, and better video and audio quality on MiniMax-H3.
sents.zh: 实验表明，在二维场景中，能量距离和在线模式比例得到改善；在 Wan2.1 上，视觉质量更优；在 MiniMax-H3 上，视频和音频质量也更好。

sents.en: User studies also favor PDMD .
sents.zh: 用户研究同样更青睐 PDMD。

paragraphs.en: DMD approximately minimizes the reverse KL divergence between a few-step student and a diffusion teacher ( Yin et al., 2024b ) . Its online critic is imperfect, and the resulting error can contribute to progressive oversaturation and reduced motion ( Yin et al., 2024a ; Xu et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ) . Adversarial distillation, such as DMD2, adds discriminator supervision. DMD2 also uses additional critic updates ( Yin et al., 2024a ; Xu et al., 2024 ; Sauer et al., 2024b ; Sauer et al., 2024a ; Lin et al., 2024 ; Lin et al., 2025 ) . These methods can improve fidelity or critic tracking, but they introduce discriminator training and coupled optimization, which can add memory and training costs and be difficult to stabilize ( Ge et al., 2026a ) . SiD, f f -distill, and SGMD instead replace the reverse-KL formulation with semi-implicit Fisher, discriminator-weighted f f -divergence, and stop-gradient Fisher objectives, respectively. Each requires additional network evaluations ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026b ) . Others keep the DMD objective and add teacher-trajectory, real-data, relational, or reward supervision ( Wu et al., 2026a ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Bai et al., 2026 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ) . ADV also identifies oversaturation and temporal collapse in few-step video distillation and counters them with an adaptively weighted regression loss and a temporal regularizer on top of DMD ( You et al., 2026 ) . PDMD keeps the DMD score networks and critic training unchanged. It changes only the student update computed from their existing predictions.
paragraphs.zh: DMD 大致最小化了少数步学生模型与扩散教师模型之间的反向 KL 散度（Yin et al., 2024b）。 其在线批评者并不完美，由此产生的误差可能导致渐进式过饱和和运动减弱（Yin et al., 2024a；Xu et al., 2025；Zheng et al., 2026）。 对抗性蒸馏（如 DMD2）增加了判别器的监督。 DMD2 还使用了额外的批评者更新（Yin et al., 2024a；Xu et al., 2024；Sauer et al., 2024b；Sauer et al., 2024a；Lin et al., 2024；Lin et al., 2025）。 这些方法可以提高保真度或批评者跟踪能力，但会引入判别器训练和耦合优化，从而增加内存和训练成本，且难以保持稳定（Ge et al., 2026a）。 SiD、f f -distill 和 SGMD 则分别用半隐式 Fisher、判别器加权的 f f -散度和停止梯度 Fisher 目标替换了反向 KL 公式。 每种方法都需要额外的网络评估（Zhou et al., 2024；Xu et al., 2025；Wu et al., 2026b）。 其他方法保留了 DMD 目标，并增加了教师轨迹、真实数据、关系或奖励监督（Wu et al., 2026a；Chen et al., 2026；Zhang et al., 2026；Bai et al., 2026；Jiang et al., 2026）。 ADV 还识别了少数步视频蒸馏中的过饱和和时序坍缩问题，并在 DMD 基础上通过自适应加权回归损失和时序正则化器进行应对（You et al., 2026）。 PDMD 保留了 DMD 的评分网络和批评者训练不变。 它仅改变了基于现有预测计算出的学生模型更新。

paragraphs.en: Consistency models enforce agreement along probability-flow ODE trajectories ( Song et al., 2023 ; Song & Dhariwal, 2024 ; Kim et al., 2024 ) . rCM extends this approach to video by adding DMD to continuous-time consistency training ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) . MeanFlow learns average velocities ( Geng et al., 2025 ) , while AnyFlow combines MeanFlow-style flow-map training with on-policy DMD through Flow Map Backward Simulation ( Gu et al., 2026 ) . SC-DMD, TMD and FSF-DMD are further hybrids, adding step-size consistency, a MeanFlow-pretrained flow head, or a critic-free update from the flow-map generator’s endpoint pseudo-velocity ( Ge et al., 2026b ; Nie et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2026 ) . These methods need another objective, rollout procedure, or training stage. PDMD requires no additional model, loss, pass, data, or stage beyond DMD.
paragraphs.zh: 一致性模型强制概率流 ODE 轨迹上的协议（Song et al., 2023；Song & Dhariwal, 2024；Kim et al., 2024）。rCM 通过将 DMD 添加到连续时间一致性训练中，将这种方法扩展到视频领域（Zheng et al., 2026）。 MeanFlow 学习平均速度（Geng et al., 2025），而 AnyFlow 则将 MeanFlow 风格的流图训练与在线策略 DMD 通过流图反向模拟相结合（Gu et al., 2026）。 SC-DMD、TMD 和 FSF-DMD 是进一步的混合方法，分别添加了步长一致性、MeanFlow 预训练的流头，或从流图生成器的端点伪速度中获得的无需批评者的更新（Ge et al., 2026b；Nie et al., 2026；Kim et al., 2026）。 这些方法需要另一个目标函数、展开过程或训练阶段。 PDMD 除了 DMD 之外，不需要任何额外的模型、损失函数、通过步骤、数据或阶段。

paragraphs.en: Adaptive noise cancellation and control variates use correlated references to reduce error or variance ( Widrow et al., 1975 ; Glynn & Szechtman, 2002 ) . DDS and FlowEdit likewise take differences between paired predictions for image editing ( Hertz et al., 2023 ; Kulikov et al., 2025 ) , while Perp-Neg and APG project guidance components ( Armandpour et al., 2023 ; Sadat et al., 2025 ) . PDMD instead projects the DMD update using the student–critic endpoint residual to suppress critic estimation error.
paragraphs.zh: 自适应噪声消除和控制变量法利用相关参考信号来减少误差或方差（Widrow 等人，1975；Glynn & Szechtman，2002）。 DDS 和 FlowEdit 同样通过计算成对预测之间的差异来进行图像编辑（Hertz 等人，2023；Kulikov 等人，2025），而 Perp-Neg 和 APG 则投影引导组件（Armandpour 等人，2023；Sadat 等人，2025）。 PDMD 则利用学生-评论家端点残差来投影 DMD 更新，从而抑制评论家估计误差。

paragraphs.en: Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) ( Yin et al., 2024b ) trains a few-step student to match the teacher distribution using the difference between an online critic score and a frozen teacher score.
paragraphs.zh: 分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）（Yin 等人，2024b）通过在线评论者得分与冻结教师得分之间的差异，训练一个少数步学生智能体以匹配教师分布。

paragraphs.en: Let G θ G_{\theta} denote the few-step student. Given Gaussian input 𝒛 \bm{z} and condition 𝒄 \bm{c} , the student produces the clean endpoint 𝒙 0 s ​ ( 𝒛 , 𝒄 ) = G θ ​ ( 𝒛 , 𝒄 ) \bm{x}_{0}^{s}(\bm{z},\bm{c})=G_{\theta}(\bm{z},\bm{c}) , a sample from the student’s final distribution. paragraphs.en: DMD2 attributes instability to the critic lagging behind the moving student and adds critic updates ( Yin et al., 2024a ) . In a two-mode model, a strong lag turns the critic’s restoring feedback into instability (Supp. Lemma A8 ). For a critic whose error arises only from this lag, the error is still the conditional mean of 𝒓 \bm{r} , so the bound of Equation 10 applies to it and the projection attenuates the lag error in conditional mean square (Supp. Corollary A9 ).
paragraphs.zh: DMD2 将不稳定性归因于批评者滞后于移动的学生，并增加了批评者的更新（Yin et al., 2024a）。 在双模模型中，严重的滞后会使批评者的恢复反馈转化为不稳定性（Supp. Lemma A8）。 对于其误差仅源于这种滞后的批评者，该误差仍然是 𝒓 \bm{r} 的条件均值，因此方程 10 的界限适用于它，且投影会减弱条件均方中的滞后误差（Supp. Corollary A9）。

paragraphs.en: Wan2.1 uses the 944 AnyFlow-augmented VBench prompts ( Huang et al., 2023 ; Gu et al., 2026 ) , at 480p with five seeds per prompt. MiniMax-H3 uses 387 VideoGen-Eval prompts ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , at 544p with mixed aspect ratios and a fixed seed. Each H3 prompt is rewritten once with Qwen3.8-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) following official guidance ( MiniMax, 2026b ) , then shared across methods. Video evaluation follows VBench; audio uses six established metrics. In randomized side-by-side comparisons on matched prompts, 20 annotators choose the better clip or a tie for text alignment, visual and motion quality, plus audio and overall quality for H3. Tables 1 and 2 report win-minus-loss shares for PDMD against each baseline (Supp. Appendix C ).
paragraphs.zh: Wan2.1 使用了 944 个经 AnyFlow 增强的 VBench 提示（Huang 等，2023；Gu 等，2026），分辨率为 480p，每个提示使用五个种子。 MiniMax-H3 使用了 387 个 VideoGen-Eval 提示（Yang 等，2025），分辨率为 544p，采用混合宽高比和固定种子。 每个 H3 提示均根据官方指南（MiniMax，2026b）使用 Qwen3.8-27B（Qwen 团队，2026）重写一次，然后在各方法间共享。 视频评估遵循 VBench；音频则使用六个成熟的指标。 在匹配提示的随机并列比较中，20 名标注员会选择更优的视频片段或判定为平局，评估维度包括文本对齐、视觉与运动质量，以及 H3 的音频和整体质量。 表 1 和表 2 报告了 PDMD 相对于各基线方法的胜减负比例（补充材料附录 C）。

paragraphs.en: In Table 1 , PDMD scores 83.73 total, above 83.54 for AnyFlow ( Gu et al., 2026 ) , 83.06 for the 50-step teacher, and 82.70 for matched DMD † . DMD † peaks at 1,500 iterations, then degrades to 63.04 at 5,000 and 56.09 at 7,500; PDMD scores 83.44 at 5,000 and stays above 83.5 through 10,000. PDMD is also 0.29 points above DMD2 † without its additional GAN loss and achieves a higher dynamic-degree score (89.72 versus 76.67). Figure 6 qualitatively shows PDMD produces higher-quality videos with natural textures and less oversaturation. Annotators prefer PDMD to every compared method, the 50-step teacher included, on visual and motion quality; text alignment is mostly ties ( Table 1 ; Supp. Table C3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在表 1 中，PDMD 的总分为 83.73，高于 AnyFlow（Gu et al., 2026）的 83.54、50 步教师的 83.06，以及匹配 DMD 的 82.70†。 DMD† 在迭代 1,500 次时达到峰值，随后下降至 5,000 次时的 63.04 和 7,500 次时的 56.09；PDMD 在 5,000 次时得分为 83.44，并在整个 10,000 次迭代中保持在 83.5 以上。 PDMD 也比没有额外 GAN 损失的 DMD2† 高出 0.29 分，并且实现了更高的动态度分数（89.72 对比 76.67）。 图 6 从定性角度展示了 PDMD 生成的视频质量更高，具有更自然的纹理和更少的过度饱和。 在视觉质量和运动质量方面，标注者更偏好 PDMD，而非所有被比较的方法（包括 50 步教师）；文本对齐方面则大多为平局（表 1；补充表 C3）。

sents.en: In Table 1 , PDMD scores 83.73 total, above 83.54 for AnyFlow ( Gu et al., 2026 ) , 83.06 for the 50-step teacher, and 82.70 for matched DMD † .

sents.en: DMD † peaks at 1,500 iterations, then degrades to 63.04 at 5,000 and 56.09 at 7,500; PDMD scores 83.44 at 5,000 and stays above 83.5 through 10,000.
sents.zh: DMD† 在迭代 1,500 次时达到峰值，随后下降至 5,000 次时的 63.04 和 7,500 次时的 56.09；PDMD 在 5,000 次时得分为 83.44，并在整个 10,000 次迭代中保持在 83.5 以上。

sents.en: PDMD is also 0.29 points above DMD2 † without its additional GAN loss and achieves a higher dynamic-degree score (89.72 versus 76.67).
sents.zh: PDMD 也比没有额外 GAN 损失的 DMD2† 高出 0.29 分，并且实现了更高的动态度分数（89.72 对比 76.67）。

sents.en: Figure 6 qualitatively shows PDMD produces higher-quality videos with natural textures and less oversaturation.
sents.zh: 图 6 从定性角度展示了 PDMD 生成的视频质量更高，具有更自然的纹理和更少的过度饱和。

sents.en: Annotators prefer PDMD to every compared method, the 50-step teacher included, on visual and motion quality; text alignment is mostly ties ( Table 1 ; Supp. Table C3 ).
sents.zh: 在视觉质量和运动质量方面，标注者更偏好 PDMD，而非所有被比较的方法（包括 50 步教师）；文本对齐方面则大多为平局（表 1；补充表 C3）。

paragraphs.en: PDMD scores 83.17 total, above every 4-NFE baseline; DMD and AnyFlow reach 82.76 and 81.97, respectively. Figures 7 and 8 show more realistic textures, more dynamic motion, and sharper details with PDMD .
paragraphs.zh: PDMD 的总得分为 83.17，高于所有 4-NFE 基线模型；DMD 和 AnyFlow 的得分分别为 82.76 和 81.97。 DMD † 在迭代次数达到 5,500 时表现最佳，此时学习率降低了十倍；若采用 PDMD 的学习率，它会在第 500 次迭代后出现过度饱和，随后性能崩溃。 图 7 和图 8 显示，使用 PDMD 生成的图像具有更逼真的纹理、更动态的运动以及更清晰的细节。

paragraphs.en: Random projection removes almost no update norm and behaves like DMD . PDMD removes a median 12 % 12\% and remains stable over the evaluated interval. The residual-parallel variant keeps only 11 % 11\% and degrades fastest, consistent with the parallel component carrying destabilizing error (Supp. Section D.2 ). Restoring half of the removed component also leads to degradation, but later than DMD (Supp. Section D.3 ). Raising the PDMD student learning rate by 1.25 × 1.25\times preserves stability through 5,000 iterations, ending at 83.18 total (Supp. Section D.4 ). DMD at one tenth of the learning rate still oversaturates and peaks at 82.76 total at 5,500 iterations, below PDMD (Supp. Table E1 ). Together, these controls show that update shrinkage alone does not explain the stability gain. In addition, with one critic update per student update, PDMD scores 82.90 total, versus 82.37 for DMD at the same update ratio, and exceeds every 4-NFE baseline in Table 2 (see Supp. Table D1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 随机投影几乎不消除任何更新范数，其行为与 DMD 类似。 PDMD 消除了中位数为 12% 的更新量（12\%），并在整个评估区间内保持稳定。 残差-并行变体仅保留 11% 的更新量（11\%），且退化最快，这与并行组件携带了导致不稳定的误差的结论一致（补充材料 D.2 节）。 恢复被移除组件的一半也会导致性能下降，但晚于 DMD（补充材料 D.3 节）。 将 PDMD 的学生学习率提高 1.25 倍（1.25\times），可在 5,000 次迭代中保持稳定性，最终总分为 83.18（补充材料 D.4 节）。 即使将 DMD 的学习率降至十分之一，它仍会出现过饱和现象，并在 5,500 次迭代时达到 82.76 的总分，低于 PDMD（补充材料 E1 表）。 综合来看，这些对照实验表明，仅靠更新收缩无法解释稳定性的提升。 此外，在每次学生更新中仅执行一次批评者更新的情况下，PDMD 的总分为 82.90，而 DMD 在相同更新比例下的总分为 82.37；同时，PDMD 的表现超过了表 2 中所有 4-NFE 基线模型（参见补充材料 D1 表）。

paragraphs.en: We introduced PDMD , a one-line DMD modification that projects out the component of the student update parallel to the student–critic endpoint residual, an unbiased estimate of critic error at a fixed query. Under high-dimensional assumptions, the projection removes a constant fraction of critic error while discarding a vanishing fraction of useful signal. PDMD requires no additional objective, network, model pass, data, or training stage. Across Wan2.1 and MiniMax-H3, PDMD remains stable in settings where DMD degrades, improves video scores, is preferred to the compared 4-NFE baselines in user studies, and performs best on all audio metrics in Table 2 . These results highlight PDMD as a promising approach to stable few-step video distillation. PDMD further opens up opportunities to combine critic-error filtering with existing distillation methods as a future work.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 PDMD，这是一种单行 DMD 修改方法，它将学生更新中平行于学生-评论家端点残差的分量投影出去，从而得到在固定查询下评论家误差的无偏估计。 在高维假设下，该投影会移除一个恒定比例的评论家误差，同时仅丢弃一个趋于零比例的有用信号。 PDMD 不需要任何额外的目标函数、网络、模型遍历、数据或训练阶段。 在 Wan2.1 和 MiniMax-H3 上，PDMD 在 DMD 性能下降的设置中仍能保持稳定，并提升了视频得分；在用户研究中，它优于所比较的 4-NFE 基线方法，并且在表 2 的所有音频指标中表现最佳。 这些结果凸显了 PDMD 是一种有望实现稳定少步视频蒸馏的有效方法。 PDMD 还为未来工作提供了将评论家误差过滤与现有蒸馏方法相结合的新机遇。

sents.en: Across Wan2.1 and MiniMax-H3, PDMD remains stable in settings where DMD degrades, improves video scores, is preferred to the compared 4-NFE baselines in user studies, and performs best on all audio metrics in Table 2 .

paragraphs.en: This work distills two released text-to-video models using existing training prompts and public evaluation benchmarks, without real-video data. The only newly collected data are human preference judgments for the user studies. A distilled student inherits the capabilities and biases of its teacher, and faster generation lowers the cost of producing misleading video. We have not evaluated whether distillation preserves the safety behavior of the base models.
paragraphs.zh: 这项工作利用现有的训练提示和公开评估基准，在没有真实视频数据的情况下，对两个已发布的文本到视频模型进行了蒸馏。 唯一新收集的数据是用户研究中关于人类偏好的判断。 经过蒸馏的学生模型会继承其教师模型的能力与偏见，而更快的生成速度降低了生成误导性视频的成本。 我们尚未评估蒸馏过程是否保留了基础模型的安全行为。

paragraphs.en: We will release the training and evaluation code of the video and 2D experiments, the distilled Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B student weights, and the MiniMax-H3 distillation LoRA. and Equation 4 give the complete student update; the projection is the only change from DMD , so the method adds one line to an existing DMD implementation. Supp. Appendix C lists every training setting of the video experiments, including the trainable parameters, data, clip size, batch, optimizer, learning rates, critic update ratio and samplers (Supp. Table C1 ), and describes the baselines and the evaluation protocols of MiniMax-H3 (Supp. Section C.2 ) and Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B (Supp. Section C.1 ), with the prompt sets, seeds, samplers and metric definitions. Supp. Appendix B specifies the 2D experiments, and Supp. Appendix A gives the full proofs of the theoretical results.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将发布视频和 2D 实验的训练与评估代码、蒸馏后的 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 学生模型权重，以及 MiniMax-H3 蒸馏 LoRA。公式 4 给出了完整的模型更新过程；投影部分是相对于 DMD 的唯一改动，因此该方法只需在现有的 DMD 实现中添加一行代码。补充材料附录 C 列出了视频实验的所有训练设置，包括可训练参数、数据、片段大小、批量大小、优化器、学习率、评论家更新比例和采样器（补充材料表 C1），并描述了 MiniMax-H3（补充材料章节 C.2）和 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B（补充材料章节 C.1）的基线模型与评估协议，同时提供了提示词集、随机种子、采样器和指标定义。补充材料附录 B 详细说明了 2D 实验，而补充材料附录 A 则给出了理论结果的完整证明。

paragraphs.en: Thus, under the stated assumptions, error alignment is structural, whereas signal alignment is asymptotically weak: PDMD removes a constant fraction of critic-error energy, while the fraction of ideal-signal energy removed along the same rank-one direction vanishes with effective dimension.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，在上述假设下，误差对齐是结构性的，而信号对齐则是渐近无力的：PDMD 会移除一个恒定比例的批评者误差能量，而沿同一秩一方向被移除的理想信号能量的比例则会随着有效维度的增加而消失。

paragraphs.en: Although 𝒅 ⋆ \bm{d}^{\star} and 𝒆 \bm{e} are not observable on MiniMax-H3, the removed component itself can be decoded and seen. The same update target, decoded with and without the projection, loses its speckle and keeps its content ( Figure 3 ; Figure E1 ; Section E.1 ). Three further measurements point the same way. The kept component carries more than 80 % 80\% of the update norm for most of training ( Section D.2 ). Removing any of four other directions instead does not stabilize training ( Section 6 , Section D.2 ). Putting half of the removed component back brings the degradation back ( Section D.3 ). The removed direction carries the destabilizing part of the update, and training with the projected update stays stable where DMD degrades ( Figure 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 尽管 𝒅 ⋆ \bm{d}^{\star} 和 𝒆 \bm{e} 在 MiniMax-H3 上无法被观测到，但被移除的组件本身可以被解码并观察到。 相同的更新目标，无论是否经过投影进行解码，都会失去其斑点特征，但保留其内容（图 3；图 E1；第 E.1 节）。 另外三项测量结果也指向了相同的方向。 在训练的大部分阶段，保留的组件承载了超过 80 % 80\% 的更新范数（第 D.2 节）。 相反，移除其他四个方向中的任何一个都无法使训练稳定下来（第 6 节，第 D.2 节）。 将移除的组件中的一部分重新加入，会使性能退化现象重现（第 D.3 节）。 被移除的方向承载了更新中导致不稳定的部分，而使用经过投影的更新进行训练时，在 DMD 出现退化的地方仍能保持稳定（图 2）。

paragraphs.en: Three further properties favor the projection. The projection never reverses the DMD direction: ⟨ 𝑷 𝑹 ⟂ ​ 𝒅 , 𝒅 ⟩ = ‖ 𝑷 𝑹 ⟂ ​ 𝒅 ‖ 2 ≥ 0 \langle\bm{P}_{\bm{R}}^{\perp}\bm{d},\bm{d}\rangle=\|\bm{P}_{\bm{R}}^{\perp}\bm{d}\|^{2}\geq 0 for every realization, so the angle between 𝑷 𝑹 ⟂ ​ 𝒅 \bm{P}_{\bm{R}}^{\perp}\bm{d} and 𝒅 \bm{d} never exceeds 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} , whereas ⟨ 𝒅 − λ ​ κ ​ 𝑹 , 𝒅 ⟩ = ‖ 𝒅 ‖ 2 − λ ​ κ ​ ⟨ 𝑹 , 𝒅 ⟩ \langle\bm{d}-\lambda\kappa\bm{R},\bm{d}\rangle=\|\bm{d}\|^{2}-\lambda\kappa\langle\bm{R},\bm{d}\rangle turns negative once the subtracted term is large and aligned with 𝒅 \bm{d} . The projection never lengthens the update, ‖ 𝑷 𝑹 ⟂ ​ 𝒅 ‖ ≤ ‖ 𝒅 ‖ \|\bm{P}_{\bm{R}}^{\perp}\bm{d}\|\leq\|\bm{d}\| , whereas 𝒅 − λ ​ κ ​ 𝑹 \bm{d}-\lambda\kappa\bm{R} can be longer than 𝒅 \bm{d} . The projection is invariant to any nonzero rescaling of 𝑹 \bm{R} , whereas subtraction needs κ \kappa at every noise level, and an overestimate flips the remaining error. paragraphs.en: In graphics, a biased estimator with smaller variance often replaces an unbiased one to lower the mean squared error ( Zwicker et al., 2015 ) . A biased critic-error estimate with smaller mean-squared deviation offers a related tradeoff in our analysis. The proofs use 𝝃 \bm{\xi} only through ‖ 𝝃 ‖ 2 \|\bm{\xi}\|^{2} and 𝒆 𝖳 ​ 𝝃 \bm{e}^{\mathsf{T}}\bm{\xi} . Let the subtracted endpoint deviate from 𝒄 ⋆ \bm{c}^{\star} by 𝝃 ′ = 𝒎 + 𝜻 \bm{\xi}^{\prime}=\bm{m}+\bm{\zeta} with a fixed 𝒎 \bm{m} and a centered 𝜻 \bm{\zeta} , so 𝑹 ′ = 𝒆 − 𝝃 ′ \bm{R}^{\prime}=\bm{e}-\bm{\xi}^{\prime} has bias − 𝒎 -\bm{m} , and write τ ′ = ‖ 𝒎 ‖ 2 + tr ⁡ Cov ⁡ ( 𝜻 ) \tau^{\prime}=\|\bm{m}\|^{2}+\operatorname{tr}\operatorname{Cov}(\bm{\zeta}) . paragraphs.en: Distribution matching leaves the allocation of mass between separated modes weakly constrained, and the online critic sees that allocation only as it was some updates earlier. This section models the resulting feedback loop and shows that the student–critic endpoint residual observes the delayed error itself. Lag is one component of the critic error 𝒆 \bm{e} of Equation 6 ; Equation 10 and Section A.2 bound the removal of the total error, and this section models the lag component alone.
paragraphs.zh: 分布匹配使得分离模式之间的质量分配受到较弱约束，而在线评论者只能看到若干次更新前的分配情况。 本节对由此产生的反馈循环进行建模，并表明学生–评论者端点残差会观察到延迟误差本身。 延迟是方程 6 中评论者误差 𝒆 \bm{e} 的一个组成部分；方程 10 和 A.2 节对总误差的消除进行了约束，而本节仅对延迟部分进行建模。

paragraphs.en: Treating this fraction as a constant gain on the scalar channel gives a one-parameter model of the projected feedback, Δ ˙ ​ ( u ) = − ρ ​ λ ​ Δ ​ ( u − τ ) \dot{\Delta}(u)=-\rho\lambda\Delta(u-\tau) , in which the stability condition of Lemma A8 becomes ρ ​ λ ​ τ < π / 2 \rho\lambda\tau<\pi/2 . The model is a heuristic: ρ \rho bounds an energy fraction in expectation, the constant-gain step stands in for a quantity that varies with the query and with the critic, and the projection also acts on the ideal update, so ρ \rho scales the lag error rather than the whole channel. The two-mode results in Table B3 are consistent with this qualitative interpretation. The gain ρ \rho tracks the state of the critic. When the critic is stale, the lag error dominates the conditional spread of the student’s endpoints, ρ → 0 \rho\to 0 , and the delayed feedback is suppressed. When the critic has caught up, 𝒆 lag = 𝟎 \bm{e}_{\mathrm{lag}}=\bm{0} , the residual is pure conditional noise, and the update passes through up to the signal-removal term of Equation A35 . The projection damps the allocation feedback when the critic is stale and releases it when the critic is current. A fixed reduction of the step, such as the random direction in Table B3 , has no such dependence.

paragraphs.en: This section tests two theoretical predictions in a minimal, fully observable setting. Experiment 1 measures whether the projection preferentially removes critic error while retaining the distribution-matching signal ( Equation 10 and Corollary A5 ). Experiment 2 measures mode allocation under critic lag and tests the attenuation of Corollary A9 .
paragraphs.zh: 本节在一个最小且完全可观察的设置中检验了两个理论预测。 实验 1 测量了投影是否在优先去除批评者错误的同时保留分布匹配信号（方程 10 和推论 A5）。 实验 2 测量了在批评者延迟情况下的模式分配，并检验了推论 A9 的衰减效应。

sents.en: This section tests two theoretical predictions in a minimal, fully observable setting.

sents.en: Experiment 1 measures whether the projection preferentially removes critic error while retaining the distribution-matching signal ( Equation 10 and Corollary A5 ).

sents.en: Experiment 2 measures mode allocation under critic lag and tests the attenuation of Corollary A9 .

paragraphs.en: Both experiments use a variance-exploding (VE) diffusion toy in ℝ 2 \mathbb{R}^{2} in which the critic error and ideal update can be estimated from student samples. The teacher score is analytic (the exact posterior-mean denoiser of the Gaussian-mixture target), so the online critic is the only learned score in the system. Experiment 1 measures its deviation from the population-optimal student score. The student is a one-step generator 𝒙 0 s = G θ ​ ( 𝒛 ) \bm{x}_{0}^{s}=G_{\theta}(\bm{z}) , 𝒛 ∼ σ max ​ 𝒩 ​ ( 𝟎 , 𝑰 ) \bm{z}\sim\sigma_{\max}\mathcal{N}(\bm{0},\bm{I}) , and the critic is an EDM-parameterized denoiser trained by denoising score matching on the student’s own re-diffused samples ( Equation 1 with α t = 1 \alpha_{t}=1 ); both are 3-layer MLPs of width 128. Training uses Adam ( β 1 = 0 \beta_{1}{=}0 , β 2 = 0.999 \beta_{2}{=}0.999 ), a learning rate of 2 × 10 − 3 2\times 10^{-3} for both networks unless stated otherwise, a batch size of 1,024, 4,000 iterations in Experiment 1 and 6,000 iterations in Experiment 2, and noise levels σ ∼ LogUniform ⁡ [ 0.02 , 5 ] \sigma\sim\mathrm{LogUniform}[0.02,5] with the standard DMD weighting. PDMD differs from the DMD variant only by the per-sample projection of Equation 4 ; seeds, data, and schedules are shared. We report the energy distance between 2,048 generated and target samples (a rotation-invariant two-sample distance, zero iff the distributions match); modes covered , the number of mixture components whose share of on-mode samples exceeds 25 % 25\% of its target share; the on-mode fraction , the share of samples within 3 ​ σ mode 3\sigma_{\mathrm{mode}} of a component center (a precision proxy); and the removed fraction , the relative reduction in update norm, 1 − ‖ 𝒅 kept ‖ / ‖ 𝒅 ‖ 1-\|\bm{d}_{\mathrm{kept}}\|/\|\bm{d}\| .

paragraphs.en: The target distribution is a ring of eight Gaussians (radius 2, standard deviation σ mode = 0.12 \sigma_{\mathrm{mode}}=0.12 ). We train five variants. Four remove one direction from the DMD update 𝒅 \bm{d} , and the unprojected baseline provides a reference: (a) DMD : no direction is removed; (b) random direction ⟂ \perp : remove a fresh random direction for each sample. In 2D, this projection removes 1 − 2 / π ≈ 36 % 1-2/\pi\approx 36\% of the update norm on average, close to the share PDMD removes. Variant (b) therefore tests whether reducing the update norm alone explains the gain; (c) critic score ⟂ \perp : remove the direction of 𝒔 critic ​ ( 𝒙 t ) \bm{s}_{\mathrm{critic}}(\bm{x}_{t}) . The critic-score direction is the closest alternative to the PDMD direction; the two differ only by the query displacement σ t ​ ϵ \sigma_{t}\bm{\epsilon} ; (d) student–teacher endpoint residual ⟂ \perp : remove 𝒓 teacher = 𝒙 0 teacher − 𝒙 0 s \bm{r}_{\mathrm{teacher}}=\bm{x}_{0}^{\mathrm{teacher}}-\bm{x}_{0}^{s} . The teacher endpoint 𝒙 0 teacher \bm{x}_{0}^{\mathrm{teacher}} comes from 𝒔 teacher \bm{s}_{\mathrm{teacher}} through the standard time-dependent rescaling and costs no extra forward pass. The teacher is exact, so 𝒓 teacher \bm{r}_{\mathrm{teacher}} contains no critic error; (e) student–critic endpoint residual ⟂ \perp : the PDMD update, which removes 𝒓 = 𝒙 0 c − 𝒙 0 s \bm{r}=\bm{x}_{0}^{c}-\bm{x}_{0}^{s} . The error-removal analysis predicts an ordering based on the information carried by each direction. The student–critic endpoint residual has the structural form 𝑹 = 𝒆 − 𝝃 \bm{R}=\bm{e}-\bm{\xi} targeted by the removal bound. The critic-score direction also contains critic error, but mixes it with the full marginal-score geometry rather than isolating 𝑹 \bm{R} ; variants (b) and (d) do not contain critic error, and variant (c) can also remove useful signal. All variants share the seed, data, and schedule. The figures show one run per variant with 200 recorded snapshots.

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 in the main text shows the training curves. Figure B2 shows the generated samples of every variant at iterations 0 , 1 , 000 , … , 4 , 000 0,1{,}000,\ldots,4{,}000 . We average each metric over the last quarter of training (iterations 3,000 3{,}000 to 4,000 4{,}000 ). PDMD reaches energy distance 0.0080 0.0080 and on-mode fraction 0.903 0.903 . DMD reaches 0.0273 0.0273 and 0.838 0.838 . The random direction reaches 0.0180 0.0180 and 0.795 0.795 . The critic-score projection reaches 0.0332 0.0332 and 0.423 0.423 . The teacher-residual projection reaches 2.04 2.04 and 0.413 0.413 ; the large error spike near iteration 3,000 3{,}000 , visible in both figures, dominates the average for this variant. Averaged over the shown 4,000 4{,}000 iterations, the random direction removes 36 % 36\% of the update norm, the critic-score projection 39 % 39\% , the teacher-residual projection 43 % 43\% , and PDMD 42 % 42\% ; the four deletions shrink the step by a similar amount. The ordering is consistent with the predicted error geometry. Among the tested directions, removing the student–critic endpoint residual is the only deletion that improves both metrics over DMD. Removing a random direction or the error-free teacher residual does not reproduce the gain. Since a rank-one deletion in d = 2 d=2 removes one of only two available directions, this experiment is a stringent signal-retention test; PDMD still improves both metrics over DMD.

To look at the mechanism itself, Figure B1 measures γ e \gamma_{e} and γ s \gamma_{s} of Section A.2 directly along the PDMD run. With the analytic teacher, this gives a Monte Carlo estimate of 𝒅 ⋆ = ( 𝒄 ⋆ ​ ( q ) − 𝒙 0 teacher ​ ( q ) ) / σ 2 \bm{d}^{\star}=(\bm{c}^{\star}(q)-\bm{x}_{0}^{\mathrm{teacher}}(q))/\sigma^{2} ; the critic error is 𝒆 = 𝒙 0 c ​ ( q ) − 𝒄 ⋆ ​ ( q ) \bm{e}=\bm{x}_{0}^{c}(q)-\bm{c}^{\star}(q) and the residual is 𝒓 = 𝒙 0 c ​ ( q ) − 𝒙 0 s \bm{r}=\bm{x}_{0}^{c}(q)-\bm{x}_{0}^{s} for the probe’s own endpoint. Every 100 iterations, 512 probes at each of 12 log-spaced noise levels in [ 0.02 , 5 ] [0.02,5] give the per-sample γ e ​ ( 𝒓 ) \gamma_{e}(\bm{r}) , γ s ​ ( 𝒓 ) \gamma_{s}(\bm{r}) , and the lower bound ‖ 𝒆 ‖ 2 / ( ‖ 𝒆 ‖ 2 + tr ⁡ 𝚺 ⁡ ( q ) ) \|\bm{e}\|^{2}/(\|\bm{e}\|^{2}+\operatorname{tr}\bm{\Sigma}(q)) of Equation 10 ; the diagnostics use a separate random stream, so the measured run reproduces the stored PDMD run bit for bit. In d = 2 d=2 a uniformly random rank-one deletion removes half of the energy of any fixed vector on average, and d eff ≤ 2 d_{\mathrm{eff}}\leq 2 , so the high-dimensional limit γ s → 0 \gamma_{s}\to 0 is not available in the plane. What the plane can test is preferential error removal: γ e \gamma_{e} exceeds γ s \gamma_{s} on average in the evaluated noise band ( Table B1 ). Figure B1 shows exactly that split: γ e \gamma_{e} peaks at 0.75 0.75 where the critic carries error, both ratios return to 1 / 2 1/2 once the critic is accurate, and the lower bound of Equation 10 holds at every snapshot and noise level. Table B1 repeats the measurement for the other three deleted directions on the same probes: the random direction sits at 1 / 2 1/2 for both ratios, the student–teacher endpoint residual removes more signal than error, and only the student–critic endpoint residual removes clearly more error than signal, 0.18 ± 0.01 0.18\pm 0.01 more error energy than the random direction and above the theoretical bound in both blocks.

Paired over the same snapshot and noise level, the student–critic endpoint residual has a lower error ratio than the random direction in 82 % 82\% of the cells in the band, than the critic score in 68 % 68\% , and than the teacher endpoint residual in 99 % 99\% . paragraphs.en: In the lag-stressed regime, PDMD yields the predicted reduction in allocation collapse ( Table B3 ): plain DMD collapses to a single mode in 14 / 20 14/20 seeds (mean final | a | = 0.355 |a|=0.355 ), while PDMD collapses in 3 / 20 3/20 (mean 0.138 0.138 ) at equal precision (mean on-mode fraction 0.973 0.973 vs. 0.970 0.970 ) and reaches a mean energy distance of 0.386 0.386 against DMD’s 1.274 1.274 . The random-direction control remains close to DMD, collapsing in 16 / 20 16/20 seeds, with a mean final | a | = 0.396 |a|=0.396 and mean energy distance 1.449 1.449 , while removing a mean 0.363 0.363 of the update norm against PDMD ’s 0.514 0.514 : the reduction follows the direction that is removed rather than the amount. The smaller step size reproduces the comparison: DMD collapses in 19 / 20 19/20 seeds and the random direction in 19 / 20 19/20 , while PDMD collapses in 12 / 20 12/20 . The trajectories are more informative than the counts ( Figure B3 ). DMD and PDMD both pass through a strongly imbalanced transient early in training (the one-step student initially covers a single mode, | a | ≈ 0.5 |a|\approx 0.5 ). Plain DMD then locks : every collapsed seed remains at | a | = 0.500 |a|=0.500 for the rest of training. PDMD recovers : a typical seed follows | a | : 0.50 → 0.40 → 0.15 → 0.03 |a|\colon 0.50\to 0.40\to 0.15\to 0.03 and then fluctuates near balance. Corollary A9 provides a model for the first part of the transition: the projection attenuates the delayed component that drives the imbalance. paragraphs.zh: 在滞后应力机制下，PDMD 实现了预测中的分配崩溃减少（表 B3）：在 20 个种子中，普通 DMD 有 14 个出现单模崩溃（最终平均 |a| = 0.355），而 PDMD 仅在 3 个种子中出现崩溃（平均值为 0.138），且两者精度相同（在模比例平均为 0.973 对比 0.970），与 DMD 相比，其平均能量距离为 0.386 对比 1.274。 随机方向控制方法与 DMD 的结果相近，在 20 个种子中有 16 个出现崩溃，最终平均 |a| = 0.396，平均能量距离为 1.449；同时，其更新范数平均减少了 0.363，而 PDMD 的减少量为 0.514：这种减少主要取决于被移除的方向，而非移除量。 第 B.1 节中剩余的两种方向方法在此设置下也减少了崩溃：评论者分数投影在 20 个种子中无一出现崩溃，而学生-教师端点残差投影则有 5 个出现崩溃，但它们的在模比例较低（分别为 0.730 和 0.871，低于 0.973）；实验 1 基于准确性排除了这两种替代方案。 较小的步长重现了这一比较结果：DMD 在 20 个种子中有 19 个出现崩溃，随机方向方法也有 19 个出现崩溃，而 PDMD 则有 12 个出现崩溃。 轨迹信息比统计数量更具说明性（图 B3）。 DMD 和 PDMD 在训练初期都会经过一个高度失衡的过渡阶段（单步学生最初仅覆盖单个模式，|a| ≈ 0.5）。 随后，普通 DMD 会锁定状态：所有已崩溃的种子在剩余训练过程中均保持 |a| = 0.500。 PDMD 则会恢复平衡：一个典型种子的 |a| 变化为 0.50 → 0.40 → 0.15 → 0.03，之后在平衡状态附近波动。 推论 A9 为这一转变的初始阶段提供了模型：投影会削弱导致失衡的延迟分量。 从经验上看，剩余的分布匹配场会将质量重新输运至平衡状态。 在 20 个 PDMD 种子中，有 17 个最终实现了两种模式的全面覆盖。

paragraphs.en: We realize delayed tracking by lowering the critic learning rate. DMD2 addresses the same critic-tracking challenge in image distillation and increases the critic update frequency so that it follows the moving student more closely ( Yin et al., 2024a ) . Our two-mode experiment makes the associated allocation response directly observable, while the video results show its large-scale signature as degradation that grows with training ( Figure 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过降低评论家学习率来实现延迟跟踪。 DMD2 解决了图像蒸馏中的相同评论家跟踪问题，并提高了评论家的更新频率，使其能更紧密地跟随不断变化的学生模型（Yin et al., 2024a）。 我们的双模式实验使相关的分配响应可以直接观察到，而视频结果则显示其大规模特征表现为随训练过程逐渐加剧的性能退化（图 2）。

sents.zh: 我们的双模式实验使相关的分配响应可以直接观察到，而视频结果则显示其大规模特征表现为随训练过程逐渐加剧的性能退化（图 2）。

paragraphs.en: This section describes the training and evaluation settings for the paper’s three experimental domains and their baselines.
paragraphs.zh: 本节介绍了本文三个实验领域及其基线模型的训练与评估设置。

paragraphs.en: We build training on the rCM codebase ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) with its consistency loss disabled and the DMD implementation of Hyper-Bagel ( Lu et al., 2025 ) , so DMD is the only objective, and train every parameter of the student from the Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B weights. Training uses 42K captions without real-video latents. The frozen Wan2.1 teacher uses guidance scale 5 throughout distribution matching. Table C1 lists the optimizer, learning rates, batch and sampler. One critic step follows every student step.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 rCM 代码库（Zheng 等人，2026）上构建训练，其中一致性损失被禁用，并使用 Hyper-Bagel 的 DMD 实现（Lu 等人，2025），因此 DMD 是唯一的优化目标，并且从 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 权重开始训练学生模型的所有参数。 训练使用了 42,000 条不包含真实视频潜变量的描述。 在整个分布匹配过程中，冻结的 Wan2.1 教师模型始终使用引导尺度为 5。 表 C1 列出了优化器、学习率、批量大小和采样器。 每个学生模型的步骤之后都会跟一个评论家步骤。

sents.en: We build training on the rCM codebase ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) with its consistency loss disabled and the DMD implementation of Hyper-Bagel ( Lu et al., 2025 ) , so DMD is the only objective, and train every parameter of the student from the Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B weights.
sents.zh: 我们在 rCM 代码库（Zheng 等人，2026）上构建训练，其中一致性损失被禁用，并使用 Hyper-Bagel 的 DMD 实现（Lu 等人，2025），因此 DMD 是唯一的优化目标，并且从 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 权重开始训练学生模型的所有参数。

sents.en: Training uses 42K captions without real-video latents.
sents.zh: 训练使用了 42,000 条不包含真实视频潜变量的描述。

sents.en: The frozen Wan2.1 teacher uses guidance scale 5 throughout distribution matching.
sents.zh: 在整个分布匹配过程中，冻结的 Wan2.1 教师模型始终使用引导尺度为 5。

sents.en: Table C1 lists the optimizer, learning rates, batch and sampler.
sents.zh: 表 C1 列出了优化器、学习率、批量大小和采样器。

sents.en: One critic step follows every student step.
sents.zh: 每个学生模型的步骤之后都会跟一个评论家步骤。

paragraphs.en: DMD2 † is our reimplementation of DMD2 on Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B, with the DMD2 discriminator head and five critic steps per student step. Its discriminator positives are clean samples generated by rolling out MiniMax-H3, chosen for their higher visual quality than Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B rollouts. These H3-generated samples provide the adversarial supervision; the distribution-matching teacher remains Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B. DMD † removes the discriminator head and the extra critic steps, so the critic and the student update once each. PDMD adds only the projection to the DMD † run. Table 1 reports DMD † at 1,500 iterations, DMD2 † at 6,500 and PDMD at 5,500, the best checkpoint of each run under the evaluation below. rCM, ADV ( You et al., 2026 ) and AnyFlow are the publicly released Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B checkpoints: rCM samples with σ max = 1600 \sigma_{\max}=1600 and intermediate times 0.783 0.783 , 0.609 0.609 and 0.406 0.406 , ADV with intermediate times 0.900 0.900 , 0.757 0.757 and 0.522 0.522 , and AnyFlow with its official 4-step bidirectional setting.
paragraphs.zh: DMD2 † 是我们基于 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 对 DMD2 的重实现，采用了 DMD2 判别器头以及每个学生步五个批评家步。 其判别器的正样本是通过运行 MiniMax-H3 生成的干净样本，因其视觉质量高于 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 的生成结果而被选中。 这些由 H3 生成的样本提供了对抗性监督；分布匹配的教师模型仍为 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B。 DMD † 移除了判别器头和额外的批评家步，因此批评家和学生各更新一次。 PDMD 仅在 DMD † 的运行基础上增加了投影模块。 表 1 报告了 DMD † 在 1,500 次迭代、DMD2 † 在 6,500 次迭代以及 PDMD 在 5,500 次迭代时的结果，这些是上述评估中各运行流程的最佳检查点。rCM、ADV（You et al., 2026）和 AnyFlow 是公开发布的 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 检查点：rCM 的样本参数为 σ max = 1600 \sigma_{\max}=1600，中间时刻为 0.783、0.609 和 0.406；ADV 的中间时刻为 0.900、0.757 和 0.522；AnyFlow 则使用其官方的 4 步双向设置。

sents.en: DMD2 † is our reimplementation of DMD2 on Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B, with the DMD2 discriminator head and five critic steps per student step.
sents.zh: DMD2 † 是我们基于 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 对 DMD2 的重实现，采用了 DMD2 判别器头以及每个学生步五个批评家步。

sents.en: Its discriminator positives are clean samples generated by rolling out MiniMax-H3, chosen for their higher visual quality than Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B rollouts.
sents.zh: 其判别器的正样本是通过运行 MiniMax-H3 生成的干净样本，因其视觉质量高于 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 的生成结果而被选中。

sents.en: These H3-generated samples provide the adversarial supervision; the distribution-matching teacher remains Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B.
sents.zh: 这些由 H3 生成的样本提供了对抗性监督；分布匹配的教师模型仍为 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B。

sents.en: DMD † removes the discriminator head and the extra critic steps, so the critic and the student update once each.
sents.zh: DMD † 移除了判别器头和额外的批评家步，因此批评家和学生各更新一次。

sents.en: PDMD adds only the projection to the DMD † run.
sents.zh: PDMD 仅在 DMD † 的运行基础上增加了投影模块。

sents.en: Table 1 reports DMD † at 1,500 iterations, DMD2 † at 6,500 and PDMD at 5,500, the best checkpoint of each run under the evaluation below. rCM, ADV ( You et al., 2026 ) and AnyFlow are the publicly released Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B checkpoints: rCM samples with σ max = 1600 \sigma_{\max}=1600 and intermediate times 0.783 0.783 , 0.609 0.609 and 0.406 0.406 , ADV with intermediate times 0.900 0.900 , 0.757 0.757 and 0.522 0.522 , and AnyFlow with its official 4-step bidirectional setting.
sents.zh: 表 1 报告了 DMD † 在 1,500 次迭代、DMD2 † 在 6,500 次迭代以及 PDMD 在 5,500 次迭代时的结果，这些是上述评估中各运行流程的最佳检查点。rCM、ADV（You et al., 2026）和 AnyFlow 是公开发布的 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 检查点：rCM 的样本参数为 σ max = 1600 \sigma_{\max}=1600，中间时刻为 0.783、0.609 和 0.406；ADV 的中间时刻为 0.900、0.757 和 0.522；AnyFlow 则使用其官方的 4 步双向设置。

paragraphs.en: We reuse AnyFlow’s evaluation end to end: its 944 augmented VBench prompts with five samples each ( 4,720 4{,}720 clips), its per-sample seeds and video writer, and the same 16 VBench dimensions and weights for the quality, semantic and total scores. All distilled rows use 4 NFEs without classifier-free guidance. The two teacher rows use UniPC with 50 and 4 steps, a shift of 8, and guidance scale 5, which doubles their NFE. The dynamic-degree column is the VBench dimension of that name.
paragraphs.zh: 我们复用了 AnyFlow 的端到端评估流程：包括其 944 个增强后的 VBench 提示（每个提示包含 5 个样本，共 4,720 个剪辑）、每个样本的种子和视频生成器，以及用于质量、语义和总分数的相同 16 个 VBench 维度和权重。 所有蒸馏行均使用 4 次 NFE，且无分类器自由引导。 两个教师行使用 UniPC，分别采用 50 步和 4 步、8 的偏移量以及 5 的引导尺度，这使得它们的 NFE 数量翻倍。 “动态程度”列即为名为“动态程度”的 VBench 维度。

sents.en: We reuse AnyFlow’s evaluation end to end: its 944 augmented VBench prompts with five samples each ( 4,720 4{,}720 clips), its per-sample seeds and video writer, and the same 16 VBench dimensions and weights for the quality, semantic and total scores.
sents.zh: 我们复用了 AnyFlow 的端到端评估流程：包括其 944 个增强后的 VBench 提示（每个提示包含 5 个样本，共 4,720 个剪辑）、每个样本的种子和视频生成器，以及用于质量、语义和总分数的相同 16 个 VBench 维度和权重。

sents.en: All distilled rows use 4 NFEs without classifier-free guidance.
sents.zh: 所有蒸馏行均使用 4 次 NFE，且无分类器自由引导。

sents.en: The two teacher rows use UniPC with 50 and 4 steps, a shift of 8, and guidance scale 5, which doubles their NFE.
sents.zh: 两个教师行使用 UniPC，分别采用 50 步和 4 步、8 的偏移量以及 5 的引导尺度，这使得它们的 NFE 数量翻倍。

sents.en: The dynamic-degree column is the VBench dimension of that name.
sents.zh: “动态程度”列即为名为“动态程度”的 VBench 维度。

paragraphs.en: The preference columns of Table 1 follow the MiniMax-H3 protocol of Section C.2 without the audio or overall-quality questions, with a pool of 20 annotators. The prompts are a uniform subset of VBench, every tenth prompt, 95 in all, and every clip uses seed 0. PDMD is paired with each of six baselines of Table 1 : the 50-step teacher, rCM, ADV, AnyFlow, DMD † and DMD2 † , 570 pairs in all, each judged on text alignment, visual quality and motion quality. Table C3 gives the win, tie and loss shares. The undistilled 4-step model is left out because many of its clips are black frames.
paragraphs.zh: 表1中的偏好列遵循C.2节的MiniMax-H3协议，但排除了音频或整体质量相关的问题，并使用了20名标注员组成的池。 提示词是VBench的一个统一子集，每十个提示词取一个，共95个，且每个剪辑都使用种子0。 PDMD与表1中的六个基线模型分别配对：50步教师模型、rCM、ADV、AnyFlow、DMD † 和 DMD2 †，共570对，每对都在文本对齐、视觉质量和运动质量方面进行评估。 表C3给出了获胜、平局和失败的占比。 未蒸馏的4步模型未被纳入，因为其许多剪辑都是黑帧。

sents.en: The preference columns of Table 1 follow the MiniMax-H3 protocol of Section C.2 without the audio or overall-quality questions, with a pool of 20 annotators.
sents.zh: 表1中的偏好列遵循C.2节的MiniMax-H3协议，但排除了音频或整体质量相关的问题，并使用了20名标注员组成的池。

sents.en: The prompts are a uniform subset of VBench, every tenth prompt, 95 in all, and every clip uses seed 0.
sents.zh: 提示词是VBench的一个统一子集，每十个提示词取一个，共95个，且每个剪辑都使用种子0。

sents.en: PDMD is paired with each of six baselines of Table 1 : the 50-step teacher, rCM, ADV, AnyFlow, DMD † and DMD2 † , 570 pairs in all, each judged on text alignment, visual quality and motion quality.
sents.zh: PDMD与表1中的六个基线模型分别配对：50步教师模型、rCM、ADV、AnyFlow、DMD † 和 DMD2 †，共570对，每对都在文本对齐、视觉质量和运动质量方面进行评估。

sents.en: Table C3 gives the win, tie and loss shares.
sents.zh: 表C3给出了获胜、平局和失败的占比。

sents.en: The undistilled 4-step model is left out because many of its clips are black frames.
sents.zh: 未蒸馏的4步模型未被纳入，因为其许多剪辑都是黑帧。

paragraphs.en: The student and critic use LoRA adapters with rank and scaling parameter 128 on the attention projections and both feed-forward layers of every DiT block; the teacher is frozen and, being guidance-distilled, is sampled without classifier-free guidance. Training uses the 248K prompt-only VidProM prompts ( Wang & Yang, 2024 ) released with Self-Forcing ( Huang et al., 2025 ) , without rewriting and without real-video data. Each GPU holds one 5-second 544p clip; training batches contain mixed aspect ratios. Table C1 lists the optimizer, learning rates, and batch size. The projection of Equation 4 is applied per sample and separately to the video and audio latents, each with its own residual 𝒓 \bm{r} . The remaining training choices follow Hyper-Bagel ( Lu et al., 2025 ) , a multi-step DMD distillation framework. We also adopt the two-timescale update rule (TTUR, several critic updates per student update) of DMD2 ( Yin et al., 2024a ) : five critic updates follow every student update, and we count every update as one iteration.
paragraphs.zh: 学生和批评者对每个 DiT 块的注意力投影以及两个前馈层使用秩和缩放参数为 128 的 LoRA 适配器；教师模型被冻结，并且由于经过引导蒸馏，因此采样时不使用无分类器引导。 训练使用了 Self-Forcing（Huang 等人，2025）发布、仅包含 24.8 万个提示的 VidProM 提示集（Wang & Yang，2024），无需重新编写提示，也无需使用真实视频数据。 每个 GPU 承载一个 5 秒长的 544p 视频片段；训练批次包含不同宽高比的视频。 表 C1 列出了优化器、学习率和批量大小。 方程 4 中的投影针对每个样本分别应用于视频和音频潜在表示，且两者各自拥有独立的残差 𝒓 \bm{r}。 其余训练设置遵循 Hyper-Bagel（Lu 等人，2025），这是一个多步骤的 DMD 蒸馏框架。 我们还采用了 DMD2（Yin 等人，2024a）的双时间尺度更新规则（TTUR，即每次学生模型更新后执行多次批评者更新）：每次学生模型更新后，会执行五次批评者更新，且我们将每次更新计为一次迭代。

sents.en: The student and critic use LoRA adapters with rank and scaling parameter 128 on the attention projections and both feed-forward layers of every DiT block; the teacher is frozen and, being guidance-distilled, is sampled without classifier-free guidance.
sents.zh: 学生和批评者对每个 DiT 块的注意力投影以及两个前馈层使用秩和缩放参数为 128 的 LoRA 适配器；教师模型被冻结，并且由于经过引导蒸馏，因此采样时不使用无分类器引导。

sents.en: Training uses the 248K prompt-only VidProM prompts ( Wang & Yang, 2024 ) released with Self-Forcing ( Huang et al., 2025 ) , without rewriting and without real-video data.
sents.zh: 训练使用了 Self-Forcing（Huang 等人，2025）发布、仅包含 24.8 万个提示的 VidProM 提示集（Wang & Yang，2024），无需重新编写提示，也无需使用真实视频数据。

sents.en: Each GPU holds one 5-second 544p clip; training batches contain mixed aspect ratios.
sents.zh: 每个 GPU 承载一个 5 秒长的 544p 视频片段；训练批次包含不同宽高比的视频。

sents.en: Table C1 lists the optimizer, learning rates, and batch size.
sents.zh: 表 C1 列出了优化器、学习率和批量大小。

sents.en: The projection of Equation 4 is applied per sample and separately to the video and audio latents, each with its own residual 𝒓 \bm{r} .
sents.zh: 方程 4 中的投影针对每个样本分别应用于视频和音频潜在表示，且两者各自拥有独立的残差 𝒓 \bm{r}。

sents.en: The remaining training choices follow Hyper-Bagel ( Lu et al., 2025 ) , a multi-step DMD distillation framework.
sents.zh: 其余训练设置遵循 Hyper-Bagel（Lu 等人，2025），这是一个多步骤的 DMD 蒸馏框架。

sents.en: We also adopt the two-timescale update rule (TTUR, several critic updates per student update) of DMD2 ( Yin et al., 2024a ) : five critic updates follow every student update, and we count every update as one iteration.
sents.zh: 我们还采用了 DMD2（Yin 等人，2024a）的双时间尺度更新规则（TTUR，即每次学生模型更新后执行多次批评者更新）：每次学生模型更新后，会执行五次批评者更新，且我们将每次更新计为一次迭代。

paragraphs.en: All DMD -family rows of Table 2 share the setup above. PDMD is reported at 3,500 iterations. DMD † is reported at 5,500 iterations of the run with both learning rates divided by ten, the best DMD run of our learning-rate search; at the PDMD learning rate DMD peaks at 500 iterations and degrades afterwards ( Figure 10 ). DMD2 † adds the DMD2 discriminator head and is reported at 500 iterations at the PDMD learning rate. The discriminator’s positive examples are clean samples generated by rolling out the frozen MiniMax-H3 teacher; no real-video data are used. The same search was run for DMD2 † , with both learning rates divided by ten and by one hundred over 0–6,000 iterations. No checkpoint of either run exceeded the DMD2 500-iteration score at the original learning rate. rCM † and AnyFlow † each port a two-stage reference recipe to MiniMax-H3; Table C2 gives both stages and Section C.2 the two places where our port departs from the reference. rCM † is reported at 2,000 iterations of its second stage and AnyFlow † at 3,000, which at their update ratios are 400 and 1,500 student updates against PDMD ’s 3,500 iterations. For both rCM † and AnyFlow † we trained three learning rates, the one in Table C2 and that rate multiplied and divided by five, and report the best of the three. We also varied the weight of the DMD term of rCM † and saw no clear difference in the final scores. H3 Turbo LoRA ( LarryVrh, 2026 ) is the released v4-600 EMA adapter.
paragraphs.zh: 表2中所有DMD家族的行都共享上述设置。 PDMD在3,500次迭代时报告结果。 DMD †在运行中于5,500次迭代时报告结果，此时两种学习率均除以十，这是我们的学习率搜索中表现最佳的DMD运行；在PDMD学习率下，DMD在500次迭代时达到峰值，之后性能下降（图10）。 DMD2 †添加了DMD2判别器头，并在PDMD学习率下于500次迭代时报告结果。 判别器的正样本是通过运行冻结的MiniMax-H3教师模型生成的干净样本；未使用任何真实视频数据。 对DMD2 †也执行了相同的搜索，在0至6,000次迭代期间，两种学习率分别除以十和一百。 两次运行中没有任何检查点在原始学习率下超过了DMD2在500次迭代时的得分。rCM †和AnyFlow †各自将两阶段参考方案移植到MiniMax-H3；表C2列出了两个阶段，而第C.2节说明了我们的移植版本与参考版本不同的两处。rCM †在其第二阶段2,000次迭代时报告结果，AnyFlow †则在3,000次迭代时报告结果，根据它们的更新比率，这相当于400和1,500次学生模型更新，而PDMD为3,500次迭代。 对于rCM †和AnyFlow †，我们训练了三种学习率：表C2中的学习率，以及该学习率乘以五和除以五后的值，并报告了三种结果中最佳的一种。 我们还调整了rCM †中DMD项的权重，但未观察到最终得分存在明显差异。 H3 Turbo LoRA（LarryVrh，2026）是已发布的v4-600 EMA适配器。

sents.en: All DMD -family rows of Table 2 share the setup above.
sents.zh: 表2中所有DMD家族的行都共享上述设置。

sents.en: PDMD is reported at 3,500 iterations.
sents.zh: PDMD在3,500次迭代时报告结果。

sents.en: DMD † is reported at 5,500 iterations of the run with both learning rates divided by ten, the best DMD run of our learning-rate search; at the PDMD learning rate DMD peaks at 500 iterations and degrades afterwards ( Figure 10 ).
sents.zh: DMD †在运行中于5,500次迭代时报告结果，此时两种学习率均除以十，这是我们的学习率搜索中表现最佳的DMD运行；在PDMD学习率下，DMD在500次迭代时达到峰值，之后性能下降（图10）。

sents.en: DMD2 † adds the DMD2 discriminator head and is reported at 500 iterations at the PDMD learning rate.
sents.zh: DMD2 †添加了DMD2判别器头，并在PDMD学习率下于500次迭代时报告结果。

sents.en: The discriminator’s positive examples are clean samples generated by rolling out the frozen MiniMax-H3 teacher; no real-video data are used.
sents.zh: 判别器的正样本是通过运行冻结的MiniMax-H3教师模型生成的干净样本；未使用任何真实视频数据。

sents.en: The same search was run for DMD2 † , with both learning rates divided by ten and by one hundred over 0–6,000 iterations.
sents.zh: 对DMD2 †也执行了相同的搜索，在0至6,000次迭代期间，两种学习率分别除以十和一百。

sents.en: No checkpoint of either run exceeded the DMD2 500-iteration score at the original learning rate. rCM † and AnyFlow † each port a two-stage reference recipe to MiniMax-H3; Table C2 gives both stages and Section C.2 the two places where our port departs from the reference. rCM † is reported at 2,000 iterations of its second stage and AnyFlow † at 3,000, which at their update ratios are 400 and 1,500 student updates against PDMD ’s 3,500 iterations.
sents.zh: 两次运行中没有任何检查点在原始学习率下超过了DMD2在500次迭代时的得分。rCM †和AnyFlow †各自将两阶段参考方案移植到MiniMax-H3；表C2列出了两个阶段，而第C.2节说明了我们的移植版本与参考版本不同的两处。rCM †在其第二阶段2,000次迭代时报告结果，AnyFlow †则在3,000次迭代时报告结果，根据它们的更新比率，这相当于400和1,500次学生模型更新，而PDMD为3,500次迭代。

sents.en: For both rCM † and AnyFlow † we trained three learning rates, the one in Table C2 and that rate multiplied and divided by five, and report the best of the three.
sents.zh: 对于rCM †和AnyFlow †，我们训练了三种学习率：表C2中的学习率，以及该学习率乘以五和除以五后的值，并报告了三种结果中最佳的一种。

sents.en: We also varied the weight of the DMD term of rCM † and saw no clear difference in the final scores.
sents.zh: 我们还调整了rCM †中DMD项的权重，但未观察到最终得分存在明显差异。

sents.en: H3 Turbo LoRA ( LarryVrh, 2026 ) is the released v4-600 EMA adapter.

paragraphs.en: Two settings could not be carried over unchanged. First, both references obtain the time derivative of the student with a Jacobian–vector product, which MiniMax-H3 does not support, so we use the finite-difference tangent that the reference implementation also provides (its fd_type=2 ) and approximate d ​ u / d ​ t \mathrm{d}u/\mathrm{d}t by finite differences in both ports. Second, the AnyFlow † flow-map stage uses ϵ = 0.005 \epsilon=0.005 , a fresh coupling per step, flow-map ratios 0.5 0.5 and 0.25 0.25 , and fp32 embedders; its second stage applies DMD to the rollout endpoint with N ∈ { 2 , 4 , 8 , 16 , 50 } N\in\{2,4,8,16,50\} , and keeps the reference’s rule that the critic and student learning rates are equal.
paragraphs.zh: 有两个设置无法直接沿用不变。 首先，两种参考方法都通过雅可比-向量积获取学生的时间导数，而 MiniMax-H3 不支持这一操作，因此我们使用参考实现也提供的有限差分切线（其 fd_type=2），并在两个端口处通过有限差分近似计算 d ​ u / d ​ t \mathrm{d}u/\mathrm{d}t。 其次，AnyFlow † 流映射阶段使用 ϵ = 0.005 \epsilon=0.005、每步一次的新耦合、流映射比 0.5 0.5 和 0.25 0.25，以及 fp32 嵌入器；其第二阶段对展开终点应用 DMD，其中 N ∈ { 2 , 4 , 8 , 16 , 50 } N\in\{2,4,8,16,50\}，并沿用参考方法的规则，即批评者与学生的学习率相等。

paragraphs.en: Every MiniMax-H3 score in the paper, including the per-checkpoint tracking of Section 6 , is computed on all 387 prompts of VideoGen-Eval ( Yang et al., 2025 ) with one harness; we do not reimplement any scoring rule. Each prompt is rewritten once with Qwen3.8-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) , using the official MiniMax-H3 video-prompt writing guide ( MiniMax, 2026b ) as the system prompt, and the same rewritten prompt is given to every method. One clip per prompt is rendered at 4 NFEs with the released scheduler (shift 12 for video and 3 for audio), 124 frames at 24 fps, seed 42, and 544p with a prompt-dependent aspect ratio: across the 387 prompts we cycle through 21 : 9 21{:}9 , 9 : 21 9{:}21 , 16 : 9 16{:}9 , 9 : 16 9{:}16 , 1 : 1 1{:}1 , 4 : 3 4{:}3 and 3 : 4 3{:}4 . Quality is computed from the seven prompt-independent VBench ( Huang et al., 2023 ) dimensions (subject consistency, background consistency, temporal flickering, motion smoothness, dynamic degree, aesthetic quality, imaging quality), normalized and weighted as in VBench. The nine semantic dimensions (object class, multiple objects, human action, color, spatial relationship, scene, appearance style, temporal style, overall consistency) follow each VBench dimension’s own rule, with Qwen3.8-27B as the vision-language judge; the semantic score is their VBench-weighted average, and the total score is ( 4 ⋅ quality + semantic ) / 5 (4\cdot\mathrm{quality}+\mathrm{semantic})/5 . Semantic dimensions differ in how many of the 387 prompts they apply to (spatial relationship 25, appearance style 30, overall consistency all 387), so we read them at the aggregate level.
paragraphs.zh: 论文中所有 MiniMax-H3 的得分（包括第 6 节中的每个检查点追踪结果）均使用单一工具包，在 VideoGen-Eval（Yang et al., 2025）的全部 387 个提示词上计算得出；我们未重新实现任何评分规则。 每个提示词均使用 Qwen3.8-27B（Qwen Team, 2026）重写一次，系统提示词采用官方 MiniMax-H3 视频提示词编写指南（MiniMax, 2026b），且所有方法均接收到相同的重写后提示词。 每个提示词生成一个视频片段，使用已发布的调度器以 4 NFEs 进行渲染（视频 shift 为 12，音频 shift 为 3），分辨率为 544p，帧率 24 fps，共 124 帧，种子值为 42；提示词相关的宽高比在 387 个提示词中循环使用 21:9、9:21、16:9、9:16、1:1、4:3 和 3:4。 质量得分基于 VBench（Huang et al., 2023）中七个与提示词无关的维度（主体一致性、背景一致性、时间闪烁、运动平滑度、动态程度、美学质量、成像质量）计算得出，并如 VBench 所示进行归一化和加权处理。 九个语义维度（物体类别、多个物体、人类动作、颜色、空间关系、场景、外观风格、时间风格、整体一致性）均遵循各自 VBench 维度的评分规则，并使用 Qwen3.8-27B 作为视觉语言判断模型；语义得分是这些维度的 VBench 加权平均值，总得分为 (4 ⋅ 质量 + 语义) / 5（4\cdot\mathrm{quality}+\mathrm{semantic})/5。 不同语义维度适用的提示词数量存在差异（空间关系适用于 25 个提示词，外观风格适用于 30 个，整体一致性适用于全部 387 个），因此我们在汇总层面读取这些得分。

paragraphs.en: The first four audio columns of Table 2 evaluate the generated audio alone: PQ, CE and CU are the production quality, content enjoyment and content usefulness of Audiobox Aesthetics ( Tjandra et al., 2025 ) , and IS is the Inception score ( Salimans et al., 2016 ) over PaSST ( Koutini et al., 2022 ) audio tags. Two additional metrics compare the audio with the video: IB is the ImageBind ( Girdhar et al., 2023 ) cosine between the audio and the video of the same clip, and DeSync is the audio–video offset in seconds predicted by Synchformer ( Iashin et al., 2024 ) ; both come from the av-benchmark suite of MMAudio ( Cheng et al., 2025 ) . PDMD leads both among the 4-NFE rows.
paragraphs.zh: 表 2 中的前四列音频评估指标仅针对生成的音频进行评价：PQ、CE 和 CU 分别代表 Audiobox Aesthetics（Tjandra et al., 2025）的生产质量、内容吸引力与内容实用性，而 IS 则是基于 PaSST（Koutini et al., 2022）音频标签计算的 Inception 分数（Salimans et al., 2016）。 另外两个指标用于将音频与视频进行比较：IB 是 ImageBind（Girdhar et al., 2023）计算出的同一片段中音频与视频之间的余弦相似度，而 DeSync 则是 Synchformer（Iashin et al., 2024）预测的音视频时间偏移量（单位：秒）；这两个指标均源自 MMAudio（Cheng et al., 2025）的 av-benchmark 套件。 在 4-NFE 行中，PDMD 的表现优于其他所有方法。

paragraphs.en: The preference columns of Table 2 come from a pairwise study on the same 387 VideoGen-Eval clips as the table, judged by 20 annotators. Each pair shows the PDMD clip and the clip of one baseline for the same prompt and seed, side by side in random left–right order, and the annotator picks the better clip or a tie on five questions: an overall judgment, text alignment, visual quality, motion quality, and audio quality. The seven baselines are the rows of Table 2 , including the 50-step teacher and the undistilled 4-step model. For each baseline and question the table reports the share of votes for PDMD minus the share of votes for the baseline, in percent, so a positive number favors PDMD and ties count for neither side. Table C4 gives the underlying win, tie and loss shares. All 387 387 pairs were judged for each baseline.
paragraphs.zh: 表2中的偏好列来自一项成对比较研究，该研究针对与表中相同的387个VideoGen-Eval片段，由20名标注员进行评判。 每对片段均展示PDMD片段与某一基线模型在相同提示和种子下的片段，以随机左右的顺序并列呈现；标注员需在五个问题上选择更优的片段或判定为平局：总体判断、文本对齐、视觉质量、运动质量和音频质量。 七个基线模型是表2中的各行，包括50步教师模型和未经蒸馏的4步模型。 对于每个基线模型和问题，表格报告了PDMD的投票份额减去该基线模型的投票份额（以百分比表示），因此正数表示更倾向于PDMD，平局则不计入任何一方。 表C4给出了底层的胜、平、负比例。 对于每个基线模型，全部387对片段均已完成评判。

paragraphs.en: The ablations of Section 6 change the projection direction only and keep every other setting fixed. This section provides additional measurements and controls for those runs. Section D.1 follows the six projection variants on three prompts to 3,000 iterations. Section D.2 compares retained update norms, and Section E.1 decodes one training batch to show what the projection removes. Sections D.4 and D.3 address two questions left open by the ablations: whether PDMD stays stable only because the projection shrinks the update, and whether a partial projection still stabilizes training. Section D.6 repeats the comparison at 2 NFE, and Section D.5 trains PDMD with one critic update per student update. Every run uses the 4-NFE MiniMax-H3 recipe of Section 6 : the same initialization, data, LoRA rank, TTUR schedule, and sampler, except where the subsection says otherwise. We save a checkpoint every 500 iterations and score each one on the 387 VideoGen-Eval prompts with the protocol of Section C.2 . Scores are in percent.
paragraphs.zh: 第 6 节的消融研究仅改变投影方向，其他所有设置均保持不变。 本节为这些运行提供了额外的测量和控制。 D.1 节对三种提示在六个投影变体下的运行进行了 3,000 次迭代。 D.2 节比较了保留的更新范数，而 E.1 节则解码了一个训练批次，以展示投影移除了哪些内容。 D.4 和 D.3 节解决了消融研究留下的两个问题：PDMD 是否仅因投影缩小了更新而保持稳定，以及部分投影是否仍能稳定训练。 D.6 节在 2 NFE 下重复了该比较，而 D.5 节则使用每次学生更新对应一次评论家更新的策略来训练 PDMD。 所有运行均采用了第 6 节的 4-NFE MiniMax-H3 方案：包括相同的初始化、数据、LoRA 秩、TTUR 调度和采样器，除非子节另有说明。 我们每 500 次迭代保存一个检查点，并依据 C.2 节的协议，在 387 个 VideoGen-Eval 提示上对每个检查点进行评分。分数以百分比表示。

paragraphs.en: The four projection variants shown in Figure D2 , trained on MiniMax-H3 in the 4-NFE setup of Section 6 , each retain one component of the DMD update 𝒅 \bm{d} and discard its complement. The error-removal ratio γ e \gamma_{e} of Table B1 is not available here: it is defined against the population-optimal critic endpoint 𝒄 ⋆ ​ ( q ) \bm{c}^{\star}(q) , which we estimate from a large student-sample bank in the 2D setting of Section B.1 . In large-scale video generation we therefore measure what is observable, how much of the update each variant retains, and read the error question from three proxies: this norm ratio, the decoded removed component of Section E.1 , and the partial-projection control of Section D.3 . We log, at every student step, the ratio ‖ 𝒅 kept ‖ / ‖ 𝒅 ‖ \|\bm{d}_{\mathrm{kept}}\|/\|\bm{d}\| between the retained component and the full update, separately for the video and the audio latents. paragraphs.en: Three observations follow. First, the random-direction variant keeps the full norm: a random direction in a high-dimensional latent space is nearly orthogonal to 𝒅 \bm{d} , so removing that component changes almost nothing, and the variant behaves like DMD . Second, PDMD removes between 8 % 8\% and 17 % 17\% of the video update norm for over 90 % 90\% of training (median 12 % 12\% ). The critic-score variant removes a median of 6 % 6\% and still degrades; it removes more only late in training, after its scores have already collapsed ( Figure 10 ). These comparisons suggest that a smaller update alone does not explain the stability of PDMD . Third, the residual-parallel variant keeps only 5 5 – 30 % 30\% of the video update (median 11 % 11\% ). This variant degenerates fastest, consistent with the parallel component containing a destabilizing part of the update. Taken together, Figure D2 shows that stability does not follow the amount removed: the random direction removes almost none of the update and degrades, the residual-parallel variant retains a median 11 % 11\% and degrades fastest, whereas PDMD retains 88 % 88\% and remains stable over the evaluated interval. What separates them is which component is removed, which is the ordering γ e \gamma_{e} measures directly in 2D.
paragraphs.zh: 以下有三项观察结果。 首先，随机方向变体保留了完整的范数：高维潜在空间中的随机方向几乎与 𝒅 \bm{d} 正交，因此移除该成分几乎不会改变任何内容，且该变体的行为类似于 DMD。 其次，PDMD 在超过 90% 的训练过程中移除了视频更新范数的 8% 到 17%（中位数为 12%）。 批评者得分变体移除了中位数 6% 的更新量，但仍会出现性能下降；它仅在训练后期、其得分已经崩溃之后才会移除更多更新量（图 10）。 这些比较表明，仅靠较小的更新量无法解释 PDMD 的稳定性。 第三，残差并行变体仅保留了视频更新的 5%–30%（中位数为 11%）。 该变体的退化速度最快，这与并行成分包含更新量的不稳定部分这一情况一致。 综合来看，图 D2 显示稳定性与移除量并无直接关联：随机方向几乎不移除任何更新量却出现性能下降，残差并行变体保留了中位数 11% 的更新量且退化最快，而 PDMD 保留了 88% 的更新量并在整个评估区间内保持稳定。 区分这些变体的关键在于被移除的具体成分，而这正是 γ e \gamma_{e} 在二维空间中直接衡量的顺序。

paragraphs.en: The DMD-family MiniMax-H3 rows of Table 2 take five critic updates per student update, the two-timescale update rule (TTUR) of DMD2 described in Section C.2 . On Wan2.1, our DMD and PDMD runs take one critic update per student update, while DMD2 † takes five. We repeat PDMD on MiniMax-H3 with one critic update per student update and every other setting of Section C.2 unchanged. Table D1 compares the 1,000-iteration checkpoint of this run with the DMD † and PDMD rows of Table 2 , which keep the five critic updates, and with DMD trained with one critic update per student update, reported at 1,500 iterations, on the video and audio metrics. With one critic update per student update, PDMD scores 82.90 total, above DMD † with five and above every 4-NFE baseline of Table 2 . Our projection does not depend on the extra critic updates. paragraphs.en: PDMD does not yet yield satisfactory single-step video generation in our experiments. At 1 NFE, samples remain smeared and fall below the quality of the four-step results ( Figure 11 ). Improving single-step quality may require an additional objective, such as a discriminator loss; we leave this investigation to future work. As in graphics, where a biased estimator with smaller variance often replaces an unbiased one, using a biased critic error estimate with smaller deviation is another possible improvement ( Section A.2 ). Whether the residual direction remains the right one to be removed when a single evaluation must cover the whole video generation is left to future work.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们的实验中，PDMD 尚未能生成令人满意的单步视频。 在 1 NFE 的情况下，生成的样本仍然模糊不清，其质量甚至低于四步生成的结果（图 11）。 要提升单步生成的质量，可能需要引入一个额外的目标函数，例如判别器损失；我们将这一研究留待未来工作完成。 与图形学中的情况类似——通常用方差更小的有偏估计器取代无偏估计器——使用偏差更小但有偏的批评者误差估计值，是另一种可能的改进方法（A.2 节）。 当单次评估必须覆盖整个视频生成过程时，残留方向是否仍然是需要去除的正确方向，这一问题留待未来工作探讨。

sents.en: PDMD does not yet yield satisfactory single-step video generation in our experiments.
sents.zh: 在我们的实验中，PDMD 尚未能生成令人满意的单步视频。

sents.zh: 在 1 NFE 的情况下，生成的样本仍然模糊不清，其质量甚至低于四步生成的结果（图 11）。

sents.en: Improving single-step quality may require an additional objective, such as a discriminator loss; we leave this investigation to future work.
sents.zh: 要提升单步生成的质量，可能需要引入一个额外的目标函数，例如判别器损失；我们将这一研究留待未来工作完成。

sents.en: As in graphics, where a biased estimator with smaller variance often replaces an unbiased one, using a biased critic error estimate with smaller deviation is another possible improvement ( Section A.2 ).
sents.zh: 与图形学中的情况类似——通常用方差更小的有偏估计器取代无偏估计器——使用偏差更小但有偏的批评者误差估计值，是另一种可能的改进方法（A.2 节）。

sents.en: Whether the residual direction remains the right one to be removed when a single evaluation must cover the whole video generation is left to future work.
sents.zh: 当单次评估必须覆盖整个视频生成过程时，残留方向是否仍然是需要去除的正确方向，这一问题留待未来工作探讨。

paragraphs.en: The theory guarantees conditional error removal, not convergence of the coupled student–critic optimization. A nonvanishing error-removal fraction requires the critic error to remain appreciable relative to conditional endpoint variance, and signal retention requires weak alignment with the residual. If the useful signal aligns with the residual, the projection can remove it as well; when the critic is exact, it can still discard useful signal ( Equation A35 ). Although these assumptions cannot be verified directly on the video models, the decoded PDMD target carries visibly less high-frequency speckle than the DMD target ( Figure E1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 该理论保证了条件误差的消除，而非学生-评论家耦合优化的收敛。 非零的误差消除比例要求评论家的误差相对于条件终点对方差保持显著，而信号保留则要求与残差存在弱对齐。 如果有效信号与残差对齐，投影也能将其消除；当评论家完全准确时，它仍然可能丢弃有效信号（方程 A35）。 尽管这些假设无法直接在视频模型上验证，但解码后的 PDMD 目标明显比 DMD 目标包含更少的高频斑点（图 E1）。

paragraphs.en: Our video experiments cover two backbones, primarily at 4 NFE, and do not establish preservation of diversity across prompts and seeds. On MiniMax-H3, the 50-step teacher remains preferred in the user study despite PDMD ’s higher aggregate video score ( Table 2 ), indicating a remaining perceptual-quality gap and a limitation of the automatic metrics.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的视频实验涵盖了两种主干网络，主要是在 4 NFE 条件下进行的，并且未能证明提示词和种子参数在不同情况下能够保持多样性。 在 MiniMax-H3 上，尽管 PDMD 的总视频得分更高（表 2），但在用户研究中，50 步的 teacher 模型仍然更受青睐，这表明感知质量方面仍存在差距，也反映了自动评估指标存在局限性。
